name: ROI Dataset

summary: This project includes BOLD MRI datasets with intermittent breath modulation from healthy young and old subjects on 3T MRI.

population: Participants produced one of 5 color words under three speech conditions

name: EEG-Speech Brain Decoding Dataset
summary: EEG recordings paired with vocal audio during an overt speech production task in which participants vocalize visually presented text. Sessions are labeled by recording date and organized in BIDS-like structure.

name: EPOC
summary: EEG recordings investigating neurophysiological correlates of Post-COVID-19, with a psychomotor vigilance reaction-time task. Participants are grouped by presence or absence of self-reported cognitive symptoms; fatigue assessed by questionnaire.

name: ROAMM

name: Single-echo/multi-echo comparison pilot
summary: Pilot comparison of single-echo and complex-valued multi-echo BOLD acquisitions, with T1-weighted anatomical scans, an n-back task, and resting scans, intended for protocol evaluation, test-retest reliability, and denoising method development.

name: Dataset of emotion recognition using validated video stimuli with large-scale behavioral survey and MEG recordings
summary: Magnetoencephalography recorded while participants viewed validated emotional video clips, alongside an online survey rating the same clips and head-digitization files for co-registration, supporting brain signal-based emotion recognition research.

name: Cross-linguistic song listening fMRI dataset
summary: Task-based functional MRI from Mandarin-speaking adults with no Korean comprehension listening to Korean ballads under music-only, music-with-subtitles, and recitation-with-subtitles conditions. BIDS-organized anatomical and functional images with task event files.

name: MorseEEG-ATP
summary: Multitask electroencephalography and behavioral dataset for studying auditory temporal processing and temporal pattern discrimination using Morse code stimuli, recorded with a 62-channel system and organized in an EEG-BIDS compatible structure.

name: Motor Task Multi-Echo fMRI - fMRIPrep Derivatives
summary: fMRIPrep derivatives of a multi-echo functional MRI motor task (hand grasp) dataset, derived from ds004662 and generated for a multi-echo fMRI data analysis tutorial.

name: CrossModal Study
summary: Recordings from a cross-modal attention task in which cues prepared participants for auditory or visual targets; one block presented targets alone, another paired each target with a distractor from the other modality.

name: The mother of all experiments
summary: Probabilistic histological atlas of the human brain: 3D histology reconstructions of five human hemispheres with two stains, manual segmentation labelmaps at 0.2mm isotropic resolution, and the original ex vivo MRI.

name: The Temporal Sequence of Party Leader Incongruence
summary: High-density EEG with linked behavioral data from healthy adult partisans processing political incongruence from party leaders and their messages, organized in BIDS with event annotations, stimuli and code.

name: SUBEMOcondMRI
summary: Functional MRI and diffusion imaging with three tasks: a fear conditioning paradigm using lateralized voices, an audiovisual task with faces and voices, and an audio task, in healthy participants.

name: Ultraprocessed foods elicit distinct metabolic and neural responses when compared to non-ultraprocessed foods
summary: Functional MRI during a Becker-deGroot-Marschak food auction task in which participants bid on ultraprocessed and non-ultraprocessed foods, with AP/PA fieldmaps acquired each session.

summary: Intracranial EEG from two epilepsy patients during single pulse electrical stimulation of white matter combined with visual stimulation, studying modulation of visual responses in early visual cortex. Irrelevant stimulation data were zeroed.

name: CRUNCH Electrocortical Data During Uneven Terrain Walking
summary: Electrocortical EEG source data from younger and older adults walking on a treadmill with parametrically varied uneven terrain, with quadratic parameters extracted to evaluate the Compensation Related Utilization of Neural Circuits Hypothesis.

name: Bone conducted responses using the parallel auditory brainstem response (pABR) paradigm
summary: EEG recordings of parallel auditory brainstem responses to air- and bone-conducted stimuli, aimed at confirming feasibility of bone conduction pABR, creating normative values, and comparing responses across stimulus levels.

name: Whole-Head Cocktail Party fNIRS
population: 38 subjects performing covert and overt spatial-attention tasks
summary: Whole-head fNIRS recordings with simultaneous eye-tracking from subjects performing covert and overt spatial-attention tasks in a cocktail-party paradigm, plus resting-state and eye-movement baseline runs. No anatomical scans included.

name: Connectome 2.0 Diffusion MRI Training Datasets (in vivo)
summary: In vivo diffusion MRI training datasets acquired on a Connectome 2.0 scanner with ultra-high gradients, including raw diffusion-weighted images, b-values and b-vectors, and T1-weighted anatomical scans, defaced for sharing.

name: Cortex-specific inversion of visual responses during sleep

name: BCCWJ-MEG
summary: Whole-head MEG recorded while Japanese native speakers read newspaper articles word by word, plus T1-weighted structural images. Part of the BCCWJ-Brain collection with matching fMRI and EEG datasets.

name: HaD-PET: Effects of DMT and harmine on cerebral glucose metabolism: FDG-PET dataset

name: fMRI Dataset for Studying Propofol Anesthesia Mechanisms with Awake Baseline in Mice
summary: Resting-state functional MRI and T2-weighted anatomical images from mice during propofol-induced sleep with an awake baseline, organized in BIDS format and accompanied by Python analysis scripts.

summary: EEG recordings with simultaneous audio during overt speech production, auditory listening, and covert speech imagery tasks, acquired across several EEG systems and sessions labeled by recording date.

summary: High-density diffuse optical tomography and functional MRI recorded while healthy adults passively viewed silent natural movie clips, with separate training and repeated test stimulus sets and semantic labels.

name: BindingWM
summary: Multi-session fMRI from healthy adults performing a binding working memory task, acquired on a Siemens Prisma 3T scanner to study feature binding in visual working memory.

summary: Multisession EEG dataset from Phase II and III studies of intranasal NeuroEPO, an erythropoietin-derived formulation, in Parkinson's disease, supporting analyses of treatment exposure, EEG source activity, and cognitive outcomes.

name: Longevity of the TIME effect

name: Pizza-topping meat/vegetarian word categorization with consumer EEG (EMOTIV EPOC X)

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

population: 6,189 critically-ill patients from the MIMIC-III Waveform Database Matched Subset

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: MIMIC-III-Ext-tPatchGNN
summary: A curated, preprocessed subset of MIMIC-III formatted as a benchmark for forecasting irregular multivariate clinical time series, with patient records whose physiological measurements are sampled at irregular intervals.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

population: 100 patients in the MIMIC-III Clinical Database v1.4
summary: Clinician-labeled propositions decomposed from human-written and LLM-generated Brief Hospital Course summaries for MIMIC-III patients, built to fact-check long-form clinical text against the patient's own record.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Annotated Question-Answer Pairs for Clinical Notes in the MIMIC-III Database
summary: Annotated question-answer pairs over discharge summaries from MIMIC-III clinical notes, with questions verified or written by clinical experts, intended for testing the generalizability of clinical question answering models.

name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demo
population: a subset of 100 patients admitted to the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center

name: MIMIC-IV demo data in the Medical Event Data Standard (MEDS)

name: MIMIC-IV demo data in the OMOP Common Data Model
summary: Preliminary transformation of the MIMIC-IV demo database into an OMOP Common Data Model instance, reusing and extending template scripts and concept mappings from an earlier MIMIC-III to OMOP conversion.

name: MIMIC-IV-ECG Demo - Diagnostic Electrocardiogram Matched Subset Demo
population: 92 unique patients who overlap with the MIMIC-IV Clinical Demo
summary: Open demo subset of MIMIC-IV-ECG with 659 diagnostic 12-lead ECGs from 92 patients, sampled at 500 Hz, so researchers can assess whether the full module suits their work.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

population: Patients with ECG records in MIMIC-IV-ECG that could be linked to MIMIC-IV discharge diagnoses
summary: Derived label set linking MIMIC-IV-ECG records to emergency department and hospital discharge diagnoses, giving clinical ground truth for training and benchmarking ECG-based prediction models.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

population: 91,372 unique patients in the MIMIC-IV Clinical Database with echocardiograms conducted between 2008 and 2022
summary: Echocardiography module with structured cardiologist-recorded measurements covering chamber sizes, systolic and diastolic function, valvular morphology and Doppler hemodynamics, plus transthoracic echocardiogram DICOM image sequences, matched to MIMIC-IV patients.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Curated subset of MIMIC-IV-ECHO with apical four-chamber cine loops, manual region-of-interest masks and left-ventricular volumetric labels, plus downsampled MP4 and NPZ derivatives for segmentation and ejection-fraction model development.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Emergency department admissions database containing vital signs, triage information, medication reconciliation, medication administration and discharge diagnoses, deidentified under HIPAA Safe Harbor.

name: MIMIC-IV-ED Demo
population: A subset of 100 patients drawn from the MIMIC-IV-ED emergency department database
summary: Openly available demo subset of MIMIC-IV-ED covering 100 patients, deidentified to the same standard as the full database, intended for workshops, teaching material and exploration.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Derived time-series resource of 22,588,586 clinical events with relative timestamps, extracted as short text spans from MIMIC-IV-Note discharge summaries by contextual retrieval and Llama-3.1-8B, for clinical risk prediction.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: A MIMIC-IV subset of cardiac disease patients containing all relevant clinical examinations from admission to discharge plus final diagnoses, built to test large language models on real patient data.

summary: Curated emergency department clinical decision making cases from MIMIC-IV covering four abdominal pathologies, each with history, physical examination, laboratory tests, imaging and treatment information, for evaluating large language models.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: A process-oriented dataset extracted from MIMIC-IV for object-centric process mining, building clinical event knowledge graphs of care pathways linked to ICD-10 and SNOMED-CT, also usable for machine learning.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Over 450K open-ended instruction-following examples generated using GPT-3.5 from the MIMIC-IV electronic health record database, designed to support instruction-tuning of general-purpose large language models for clinical applications.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: A benchmark built from MIMIC-IV discharge summaries and human-verified ICD-10 codes, asking language models to verify medical concepts, including implicitly documented diagnoses, and to identify supporting sentence-level evidence.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-IV-ED data converted into FHIR resources, aligned to US Core v4.0.0 where possible, with 24 profiles for MIMIC-IV and 6 for MIMIC-IV-ED plus code systems and value sets.

summary: A 100 patient subset of the MIMIC-IV v2.2 and MIMIC-IV-ED v2.2 clinical databases reformatted into FHIR, released with open code as a benchmark for experimenting with FHIR-based tools.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Deidentified free-text notes linked to MIMIC-IV: 331,794 discharge summaries from 145,915 patients and 2,321,355 radiology reports for 237,427 patients, deidentified under HIPAA Safe Harbor, intended for clinical natural language processing.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

population: critical care patients at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center whose deidentified records appear in MIMIC-III
summary: MIMIC-III patient records converted into TensorFlow SequenceExample format, with timestamped feature lists per encounter and labels for inpatient mortality and discharge diagnosis codes, for reproducible machine learning research.

summary: Summary clinical data and outcomes for 1,776 patients extracted from MIMIC-II for a textbook case study on the effectiveness of indwelling arterial catheters in hemodynamically stable patients with respiratory failure for mortality outcomes.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

population: Patients admitted from 2001 - 2008 to an intensive care unit at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center, excluding those present in MIMIC-IV

name: MIMIC-III Waveform Database
population: About 30,000 patients in intensive care units
summary: Bedside monitor recordings from intensive care patients, including continuous ECG, PPG, arterial blood pressure and respiration waveforms plus numerics records of periodic vital sign measurements spanning each ICU stay.

population: 10,282 distinct ICU patients identified and linked to MIMIC-III clinical records
summary: Waveform and numerics records from ICU bedside monitors for patients whose corresponding clinical records exist in the MIMIC-III Clinical Database, covering ECG, blood pressure, respiration, PPG and periodic vital signs.

name: MIMIC-IV Waveform Database
summary: Physiological signals and measurements taken directly from ICU bedside monitors, including electrocardiograms, photoplethysmograms, respiration and invasive and non-invasive blood pressure, intended to be combined with MIMIC-IV clinical information.

name: MIMIC Database
summary: Bedside monitor signals and periodic measurements paired with medical record data for ICU patients; recordings vary in length, most lasting at least twenty hours and many considerably longer.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: MIMIC-III Clinical Database
population: Over forty thousand patients who stayed in critical care units of the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center between 2001 and 2012
summary: Deidentified records from critical care stays, covering demographics, bedside vital signs, laboratory results, procedures, medications, caregiver notes, imaging reports and mortality, supporting epidemiology, clinical decision-rule and tool development studies.

name: MIMIC-III Clinical Database Demo
population: 100 patients also present in the MIMIC-III Clinical Database
summary: An open demo subset of the MIMIC-III Clinical Database, manually curated so researchers can judge whether the full credentialed database suits their work. Free-text notes are excluded.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: MIMIC-IV

summary: Minute-level step counts derived from five algorithms applied to raw wrist accelerometry, plus activity counts, MIMS, and wear predictions, for NHANES participants who wore accelerometers.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Paired arterial and peripheral oxygen saturation measurements derived from an intensive care database, intended for building pulse oximetry correction models addressing measurement bias across skin tones.

name: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database
population: 47 subjects studied by the BIH Arrhythmia Laboratory between 1975 and 1979, a mixed population of inpatients and outpatients
summary: Half-hour excerpts of two-channel ambulatory electrocardiogram recordings from subjects studied at an arrhythmia laboratory, partly randomly selected and partly chosen to include less common arrhythmias.

name: Multilevel Monitoring of Activity and Sleep in Healthy People
summary: Twenty-four hours of beat-to-beat heart data, accelerometry, sleep quality, physical activity, psychological characteristics, salivary cortisol and melatonin, and activity logs from healthy participants.

name: MMG Database
population: 25 subjects who presented themselves in the Triage unit of Labor and Delivery and were undergoing monitoring and evaluation of labor
summary: Uterine magnetomyographic signals from 25 subjects recorded using a 151 channel Reproductive Assessment system.

name: Motion Artifact Contaminated fNIRS and EEG Data
summary: Example functional near-infrared spectroscopy and electroencephalogram recordings contaminated by motion artifact, contributed for the purpose of evaluating artifact removal methods.

name: Longitudinal Cylinder Rearing Behavioral Data in a Mouse Stroke Model Across Multiple Drug Treatments

summary: Longitudinal cylinder rearing videos and frame-level paw-usage annotations from mice in a stroke model across four drug treatment groups, assessed at baseline, maximal deficit, and recovery timepoints.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Phrase grounding benchmark pairing chest X-ray bounding boxes with radiology sentence descriptions, annotated and verified by board-certified radiologists, covering eight cardiopulmonary radiological findings. Complements the MIMIC-CXR v.2 dataset.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: MS-CXR-T: Learning to Exploit Temporal Structure for Biomedical Vision-Language Processing
summary: Multimodal benchmark extending MIMIC-CXR v2 with radiologist-verified annotations for two temporal tasks: classifying disease progression from multi-image frontal chest X-rays, and judging temporal-semantic similarity of radiology sentence pairs.

name: MAMEM SSVEP Database
population: 11 subjects recorded under stimulation of flickering lights
summary: EEG recordings collected while subjects viewed flickering light stimulation, used to study steady state visually evoked potentials. Data are divided into three sets differing in experimental procedure and capturing device.

name: A multi-camera and multimodal dataset for posture and gait analysis
population: 14 healthy participants walking at 3 different gait speeds, across 3 different walking scenarios/paths at 3 different locations
summary: Multimodal recordings of walking with a wheeled robotic walker, combining synchronized depth camera video and inertial motion capture skeleton joint data, for vision-based pose estimation and gait and posture analysis.

access_notes: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
license: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

summary: Benchmark derived from MIMIC-IV for multimodal decision support in emergency departments, covering demographics, biometrics, vital signs, lab results and ECG waveforms from early after arrival, with diagnosis and deterioration prediction targets.

name: A multimodal gait dataset of brain activity, muscle activity, kinematics and ground forces in young adults
population: 59 healthy adults with a mean age of 24 ± 5 years, representing both sexes and different body mass index categories
summary: Treadmill walking recordings at three controlled speeds combining scalp EEG, surface EMG of lower-limb muscles, inertial kinematics and force plate ground reaction data, supporting study of brain-body interactions during gait.

summary: Multimodal physiological and behavioral recordings during n-back working memory tasks performed while calming or exciting background music played, investigating music as an intervention to regulate cognitive arousal and performance states.

summary: Spatiotemporally aligned satellite images of Colombian municipalities with matched economic, demographic, meteorological, and epidemiological metadata, extracted via the SentinelHub API, intended for multimodal public health analysis in low- and middle-income settings.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Multimodal Physiological Indices During Surgery Under Anesthesia
population: patients under anesthesia during surgery (101 surgeries)
summary: Prospective multi-sensor physiological recordings from surgeries under anesthesia, with annotated nociceptive stimuli and administered medications, used to derive indices of autonomic nervous system activity from cardiac and sweat gland signals.

name: MICRO Motion capture data from groups of participants standing still to auditory stimuli (2012)
population: 113 participants at the University of Oslo, March 8th 2012
summary: Head motion recorded with an infra-red optical motion capture system while groups of participants stood still for six minutes, three in silence followed by three with music, to study music-induced micromotion.

name: MICRO Motion capture data from groups of participants standing still to auditory stimuli (2015)
population: 108 participants at the University of Oslo, March 12th 2015
summary: Head movement data recorded with a motion capture system while groups of participants stood as still as possible during a series of auditory stimuli, studying how music influences small magnitude motion.

name: MUSIC (Sudden Cardiac Death in Chronic Heart Failure)
population: 992 patients with CHF consecutively enrolled from specialized HF clinics of eight University Spanish Hospitals, enrolled April 2003 to December 2004
summary: Prospective multicentre longitudinal study of ambulatory chronic heart failure patients, with resting and Holter ECG, chest X-ray, echocardiography and blood laboratory data at enrolment, following cardiac death and sudden cardiac death outcomes.

name: Spontaneous Ventricular Tachyarrhythmia Database
summary: Paired RR interval time series recorded by implanted cardioverter defibrillators, each pair containing one series with a spontaneous ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation episode and one sample of intrinsic, usually sinus, rhythm.

name: Myocardial perfusion scintigraphy image database
population: patients undergoing scintigraphy examinations to investigate cardiac conditions, age range 20 to 90 years
summary: Anonymized myocardial perfusion scintigraphy images in DICOM format with metadata and segmentation masks in NIfTI format, covering diverse perfusion patterns and cardiac conditions, for image processing and algorithm development.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

population: Pediatric patients who had sleep studies at Nationwide Children's Hospital in Columbus, Ohio, USA between 2017 and 2019

name: Noise Enhancement of Sensorimotor Function
population: 27 healthy volunteers: 15 healthy young (mean age 23) and 12 healthy elderly (mean age 73)
summary: Postural sway recordings from healthy young and elderly volunteers, collected during timed standing tests split into 30-second trials, with a seated break midway through each test.

name: Neurophysiological Dataset of Stress Resilience During Human-Computer Interaction
population: 35 participants engaged in a computer-based task under stress
summary: Multimodal neurophysiological and physiological recordings during a computer-based stressful task, spanning baseline, stress and recovery phases, with synchronized event markers, subjective resilience scores and demographic variables.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Neurocritical care waveform recordings in pediatric patients
population: 12 pediatric neurocritical care patients with a variety of pathologies necessitating invasive intracranial pressure monitoring
summary: De-identified time-locked bedside waveform recordings from pediatric neurocritical care, including arterial blood pressure, intracranial pressure and cerebral blood flow velocity, plus hematocrit and transducer height information.

name: Non-Invasive Fetal ECG Arrhythmia Database
population: Fetuses with arrhythmias (n=12) and controls with normal rhythm (n=14)
summary: Non-invasive fetal electrocardiography recordings of fetal arrhythmias together with control recordings of normal fetal rhythm, intended for study of irregular fetal cardiac rhythms.

name: Non-Invasive Fetal ECG Database
population: A single subject recorded between 21 to 40 weeks of pregnancy
summary: Multichannel abdominal non-invasive fetal electrocardiogram recordings of variable duration, taken weekly from one pregnant subject across gestation, useful for testing signal separation algorithms.

name: NInFEA: Non-Invasive Multimodal Foetal ECG-Doppler Dataset for Antenatal Cardiology Research
population: 60 entries from 39 voluntary pregnant women, between the 21st and the 27th week of gestation
summary: Open dataset of simultaneous non-invasive electrophysiological recordings, fetal pulsed-wave Doppler and maternal respiration signals, giving ground truth on fetal heart activity when an invasive scalp lead is unavailable.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: ODD: A Benchmark Dataset for the NLP-based Opioid Related Aberrant Behavior Detection
population: Patients whose electronic health record notes document opioid related aberrant behaviors
summary: Expert-annotated benchmark of electronic health record notes labeled for opioid-related aberrant behaviors, with multi-label categories covering confirmed and suggested aberrant behavior, opioids, indications, dependency, medication changes and social determinants of health.

name: Non-EEG Dataset for Assessment of Neurological Status
summary: Wrist-worn biosensor recordings of electrodermal activity, temperature, acceleration, heart rate and arterial oxygen level from healthy subjects, used to infer neurological status across stress and relaxation states.

name: Norwegian Endurance Athlete ECG Database
population: 28 healthy elite athletes from various sports in Norway
summary: Resting 12-lead ECG recordings from healthy elite endurance athletes, each interpreted both by an automated algorithm and by a cardiologist using the International Criteria for ECG interpretation.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Nosocomial Risk Datasets from MIMIC-III
population: Hospitalized critical care patients, with distinct positive and negative cohorts extracted per disease
summary: Longitudinal text-based cohorts derived from MIMIC-III for predicting hospital-acquired acute kidney injury, pressure injury and anemia in advance from clinical notes, with retrospectively determined dates of event.

name: neuroQWERTY MIT-CSXPD Dataset

summary: Keystroke logs from subjects with and without Parkinson's disease, collected to examine whether routine computer keyboard interaction can reveal motor signs in early-stage disease.

name: Normal Sinus Rhythm RR Interval Database

name: MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database
population: 18 subjects referred to the Arrhythmia Laboratory at Boston's Beth Israel Hospital (5 men, aged 26 to 45, and 13 women, aged 20 to 50)

name: MIT-BIH Noise Stress Test Database

summary: Half-hour ECG recordings together with recordings of noise typical of ambulatory ECG, made with standard recorders, leads and electrodes placed so that subjects' ECGs were not visible.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

name: OB-1 Fetal ECG Database
population: Fetuses recorded via scalp electrograms, with simultaneous uterine muscular activity
summary: A developing collection of fetal scalp electrogram and uterine muscular activity recordings with beat-by-beat fetal ECG annotations, intended to support studies of fetal heart rate variability.

population: 32 healthy participants: 15 "young" aged 32 or younger and 17 "old" aged 64 or older
summary: Synchronized motion capture, force plate, and FMCW radar recordings of healthy younger and older participants performing the One-Legged Stand Test, with labeled foot-lift, stability, and foot-touchdown events.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Organ Retrieval and Collection of Health Information for Donation (ORCHID)
population: Deceased donor organ procurement cases from six organ procurement organizations (OPOs)
summary: A multi-center dataset on deceased donor organ procurement, covering ten years of clinical, financial, and administrative information from six organ procurement organizations, to study and improve procurement practice.

name: Pattern Analysis of Oxygen Saturation Variability
summary: One hour of oxygen saturation measurements per patient, collected for analysis of oxygen saturation variability.

name: PADS - Parkinsons Disease Smartwatch dataset
population: 469 individuals: Parkinsons disease patients, differential diagnoses, and healthy controls
summary: Smartwatch and smartphone acceleration and rotation recordings from interactive neurological movement tasks in Parkinson's patients, people with similar movement disorders, and healthy controls, plus demographics, medical history, and non-motor symptoms.

name: Patient-level dataset to study the effect of COVID-19 in people with Multiple Sclerosis
population: People with multiple sclerosis (PwMS), with data entered by patients and clinicians
summary: An anonymised patient-level dataset from the COVID-19 in MS Global Data Sharing Initiative, entered by patients and clinicians, covering demographics, comorbidities, hospital stay, and COVID-19 symptoms.

name: A Comprehensive Dataset of Pattern Electroretinograms for Ocular Electrophysiology Research: The PERG-IOBA Dataset
population: 304 subjects evaluated at the Institute of Applied Ophthalmobiology (IOBA), University of Valladolid, from 2003 to 2022
summary: Pattern electroretinogram recordings in CSV format from subjects evaluated at IOBA, with at least one signal per eye, plus age, gender, diagnoses, and logMar visual acuity.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: PatientSim: A Persona-Driven Simulator for Realistic Doctor-Patient Interactions
population: Simulated patient personas grounded in clinical profiles derived from the MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV datasets
summary: A patient simulator generating diverse patient personas for multi-turn doctor-patient dialogue, built on clinical profiles drawn from MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV, with personas defined along personality, language proficiency, history recall and cognitive confusion axes.

name: Permittivity of Healthy and Diseased Skeletal Muscle
population: Healthy and diseased human skeletal muscle
summary: Shared measurements of conductivity and relative permittivity in healthy and diseased skeletal muscle, intended as normative data for improving neuromuscular evaluation techniques and developing new diagnostic tools.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Phenotype Annotations for Patient Notes in the MIMIC-III Database
population: Patients of Intensive Care Units of a large tertiary care hospital in Boston, from MIMIC-III
summary: MIMIC-III patient notes manually annotated by two expert annotators for high-context phenotypes such as treatment non-adherence, chronic pain and advanced cancer, supporting patient phenotyping and clinical natural language processing research.

name: PhysioZoo - mammalian NSR databases
population: Conscious mammals (dogs, rabbits, mice), no drugs administered prior to recording
summary: Electrocardiographic recordings from several mammal species, each record supplied with the raw ECG signal, human-corrected R-peak annotations and signal quality annotations in MATLAB, text and PhysioNet formats for heart rate variability study.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Paediatric Intensive Care database
population: Children admitted to critical care units at a large children's hospital in China
summary: A de-identified, bilingual single-centre database of children admitted to critical care units, covering vital signs, medications, laboratory results, fluid balance, diagnostic codes and demographics, available after credentialing.

name: Preterm Infant Cardio-Respiratory Signals Database
population: Ten preterm infants from the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit of the University of Massachusetts Memorial Healthcare
summary: Simultaneous ECG and respiration recordings from preterm infants in a neonatal intensive care unit, used with linear heart rate features to predict bradycardia episodes.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: PIFIR: PET-CT Invasive Fungal Infection Reports
population: Patients whose PET-CT imaging reports were de-identified and annotated; 201 reports
summary: A corpus of 201 de-identified PET-CT reports annotated by radiologists for terminology suggestive of invasive fungal infection, including concepts, certainty cues and relations, released with the annotation schema for named entity recognition and relation extraction.

name: Modulation of Plantar Pressure and Muscle During Gait
population: 20 healthy male adults with no history of either neurological or orthopedic impairments
summary: Plantar pressure distribution and activity of two lower-leg muscles recorded during gait in healthy adults, collected to study how electrical stimulation of tibialis anterior affects pressure and gastrocnemius medialis activity.

name: A Pressure Map Dataset for In-bed Posture Classification
summary: Pressure sensor recordings from adult participants lying in various sleeping postures, collected with two types of pressure sensing mats, for in-bed posture classification.

name: Physiologic Response to Changes in Posture
summary: Physiological signals, including ECG and blood pressure, recorded in healthy subjects during a slow tilt, a fast tilt, and a standing-up maneuver.

name: Pressure, flow, and dynamic thoraco-abdominal circumferences data for adults breathing under CPAP therapy
population: 30 healthy adults at the University of Canterbury
summary: Airway pressure, flow, and chest and abdominal circumference recordings from healthy adults breathing under CPAP at several PEEP settings and three breath patterns, plus a demographic questionnaire.

access_notes: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
license: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0
name: Behavioral and autonomic dynamics during propofol-induced unconsciousness
summary: Point process indices of heart rate variability and electrodermal activity, with behavioral measures, recorded from healthy volunteers during computer-controlled propofol sedation increased and then decreased in stages.

name: PSG-IPA: A PolySomnoGraphic Inter-scorer Performance Assessment database
population: 20 polysomnography (PSG) recordings, scored by 12 independent expert sleep technologists
summary: Polysomnography recordings with EEG, EOG, EMG, ECG and respiratory signals, each accompanied by manual and computer-assisted scorings from independent expert sleep technologists, for studying inter-scorer variability and automated sleep analysis.

name: PTB-XL, a large publicly available electrocardiography dataset
summary: Clinical 12-lead ECG recordings of ten second length from patients, annotated by up to two cardiologists with SCP-ECG diagnostic, form, and rhythm statements, with metadata and recommended train/test splits.

name: PTB-XL+, a comprehensive electrocardiographic feature dataset
summary: Feature dataset supplementing PTB-XL, with ECG features from two commercial and one open-source algorithm in a harmonized format, median beats or fiducial points, and automatic diagnosis statements.

name: PTB Diagnostic ECG Database
population: 290 subjects; healthy volunteers and patients with different heart diseases
summary: Digitized ECG recordings from subjects, collected with a non-commercial prototype recorder, provided for research, algorithmic benchmarking, or teaching.

name: Pulse Transit Time PPG Dataset
summary: Time-synchronised multi-site photoplethysmography with inertial, pressure and temperature sensor data, annotated ECG, blood pressure and SpO2 values, recorded from healthy subjects during physical activities.

name: MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database P-Wave Annotations
summary: Reference P-wave annotations for twelve signals from the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, supporting ECG waveform delineation.

name: Q-Pain: A Question Answering Dataset to Measure Social Bias in Pain Management
population: Patient-specific medical scenarios ("vignettes") allowing substitution of multiple different racial and gender "profiles"
summary: Q-Pain, a medical QA dataset designed to enable the substitution of multiple different racial and gender "profiles" for patients and to evaluate whether bias is present when deciding whether to prescribe pain medication or not.

name: Quantitative Dehydration Estimation
summary: Measurements for estimating dehydration, or total body water loss, using bioimpedance, temperature readings, and salivary and sweat samples.

name: QT Database
summary: Two-lead ECG recordings, many excerpted from other databases, with onset, peak, and end markers for P, QRS, T and U waves in selected beats.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: C-REACT: Contextualized Race and Ethnicity Annotations for Clinical Text
population: 17,281 sentences drawn from 12,000 patients and their clinical notes at the Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center critical care units between 2001 and 2012
summary: Gold-standard annotations of race and ethnicity information in clinical notes from MIMIC-III, covering country of origin and spoken language plus clinician-assigned race and ethnicity labels.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RadCoref: Fine-tuning coreference resolution for different styles of clinical narratives
summary: A subset of MIMIC-CXR radiology report sections with manually annotated coreference mentions and clusters, split into training, validation and test sets, supporting coreference resolution on radiology reports.

name: Radiology Report Generation Models Evaluation Dataset For Chest X-rays (RadEvalX)
summary: Radiologist annotations of errors in automatically generated chest X-ray reports, covering eight error categories and marking clinically significant versus insignificant errors, built to compare automated metrics against human scoring.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RadGraph: Extracting Clinical Entities and Relations from Radiology Reports
summary: Entity and relation annotations on full-text chest X-ray radiology reports, with expert-labeled train and test sets plus model-generated annotations that map to the associated chest radiographs.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RadGraph-XL: A Large-Scale Expert-Annotated Dataset for Entity and Relation Extraction from Radiology Reports
summary: Expert-annotated radiology reports spanning chest CT, abdomen/pelvis CT, brain MRI and chest X-ray, labeled with clinical entities and relations, with generalization tested on deep vein thrombosis ultrasound reports.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RadGraph2: Tracking Findings Over Time in Radiology Reports
summary: Chest radiology reports annotated with a fine-grained entity-relationship schema that also captures changes compared with prior studies, released alongside a much larger set of model-annotated reports.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RaDialog Instruct Dataset
summary: Image-grounded instruction data for chest X-ray tasks such as report generation, report correction, summarization and finding prediction, built to train a radiology vision-language dialog model.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RadNLI: A natural language inference dataset for the radiology domain
summary: Natural language inference dataset for radiology: sentence pairs sampled from radiology reports and annotated with inference labels by a medical expert and a computer science expert, split into validation and test sets.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RadQA: A Question Answering Dataset to Improve Comprehension of Radiology Reports
summary: Question answering dataset over radiology reports, with physician-created questions based on the clinical referral section and answer spans marked within the Findings and Impressions sections.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RadVLM Instruction Dataset
summary: Instruction dataset of chest X-ray image-instruction pairs covering report generation, abnormality classification, anatomy grounding, abnormality detection and phrase grounding, plus multi-turn conversations, for training chest X-ray assistants.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: ReFiSco: Report Fix and Score Dataset for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiologist ratings of error severity for chest radiology reports drawn from MIMIC-CXR, comparing reports from two generation models with a human benchmark, with raters blinded to the report source.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: REFLACX: Reports and eye-tracking data for localization of abnormalities in chest x-rays
population: Five radiologists reading 3,032 frontal chest x-ray cases from MIMIC-CXR; a subset of 109 chest x-rays was read by all radiologists.
summary: Eye-tracking recordings and time-synchronized dictation transcripts from five radiologists reading 3,032 frontal chest x-ray cases from MIMIC-CXR, with image-level abnormality labels, ellipses localizing anomalies, and bounding boxes around lungs and heart.

name: Respiratory dataset from PEEP study with expiratory occlusion
population: 80 adults, including vapers, asthmatics, smokers, and otherwise healthy people
summary: Airway pressure, flow, volume, thoracic and abdominal circumference, and electrical impedance tomography aeration recorded from 80 adults breathing on CPAP as PEEP was raised from 4 to 12 cmH2O, with rapid expiratory occlusions.

name: Respiratory and heart rate monitoring dataset from aeration study
population: 20 subjects with no known significant respiratory abnormalities
summary: Respiratory pressure and flow, electrical impedance tomography aeration, electrocardiogram, and heart-rate belt data from 20 subjects during resting breathing, CPAP at varied PEEP, breath-holds, and forced expiratory manoeuvres, plus self-reported demographics.

name: Respiratory and Pulse Oximetry Waveforms from Healthy Adults During Simulated Apnoea Events
summary: Airway pressure, inspiratory differential pressure, and neck-worn reflectance photoplethysmography capturing arterial and venous waveforms from 20 healthy adults during simulated obstructive sleep apnoea trials at three positive airway pressure settings.

name: ReXErr-v1: Clinically Meaningful Chest X-Ray Report Errors Derived from MIMIC-CXR
summary: Chest x-ray reports derived from MIMIC-CXR with synthetic errors injected by large language models at report and sentence level, sampled from errors frequently made by human and AI report writers.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: ReXPref-Prior: A MIMIC-CXR Preference Dataset for Reducing Hallucinated Prior Exams in Radiology Report Generation
summary: An adapted version of MIMIC-CXR in which GPT-4 removed references to prior exams from the findings and impression sections of chest x-ray reports, for training and benchmarking report generation models.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Radiology Report Expert Evaluation (ReXVal) Dataset
population: 6 board certified radiologists annotating 200 pairs of candidate and ground-truth reports from 50 studies
summary: Annotations from six board-certified radiologists marking clinically significant and insignificant errors in six categories across 200 pairs of candidate and ground-truth radiology reports drawn from 50 MIMIC-CXR studies.

name: RR interval time series from healthy subjects
population: Healthy subjects aged between 1month and 55 years
summary: Long-term RR interval time series from healthy volunteers aged between 1 month and 55 years, assembled to study heart rate variability across age and development.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: RuMedNLI: A Russian Natural Language Inference Dataset For The Clinical Domain
summary: Russian-language natural language inference dataset for the clinical domain, translated from MedNLI, which was built on MIMIC-III records and annotated by doctors. Part of the RuMedBench benchmark.

name: Response to Valsalva Maneuver in Humans
population: a cohort of healthy normal volunteers
summary: Recordings used to assess baroreflex function and autonomic control of heart rate via the Valsalva maneuver, collected from healthy volunteers, with two complementary simulation methods applied.

name: Santa Fe Time Series Competition Data Set B
population: a patient in the sleep laboratory of the Beth Israel Hospital
summary: Multivariate sleep-laboratory recording of heart rate, chest volume and blood oxygen concentration sampled at 2 Hz, extracted from a polysomnographic database record and submitted to a time series competition.

name: SCG-RHC: Wearable Seismocardiogram Signal and Right Heart Catheter Database
population: an open access dataset of 73 patients
summary: Simultaneous right heart catheter pressure measurements and chest-worn wearable patch signals (ECG and seismocardiogram), with demographics, collected to study non-invasive monitoring of pulmonary arterial and capillary wedge pressure.

name: ScientISST MOVE: Annotated Wearable Multimodal Biosignals recorded during Everyday Life Activities in Naturalistic Environments
population: A total of 17 healthy volunteers participated in the experimental data acquisition sessions
summary: Annotated multimodal biosignals (ECG, EMG, EDA, PPG, temperature, actigraphy) recorded with a chestband, armband and wristband while volunteers performed everyday activities in uncontrolled environments.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: SCRIPT CarpeDiem Dataset: demographics, outcomes, and per-day clinical parameters for critically ill patients with suspected pneumonia
population: 704 patients enrolled in the SCRIPT study between June 2018 and May 2023, all of whom were critically ill patients on mechanical ventilation suspected of having pneumonia
summary: Per-day clinical parameters, demographics, physician-adjudicated pneumonia episode information and outcomes for critically ill mechanically ventilated patients who underwent bronchoalveolar lavage. Deidentified under HIPAA Safe Harbor.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: SCRIPT X2B8 Dataset: per-day clinical features to model successful next-day extubation
population: an internal cohort of 696 patients and 9,828 ICU days, and an external test cohort of 333 patients and 2,835 ICU days
summary: Daily aggregated electronic health record features for ICU patients on mechanical ventilation, with annotations of intubation, extubation, tracheostomy days and failed extubation, plus next-day extubation labels for internal and external cohorts.

name: Sudden Cardiac Death Holter Database
population: 18 patients with underlying sinus rhythm (4 with intermittent pacing), 1 who was continuously paced, and 4 with atrial fibrillation
summary: Holter electrocardiogram recordings assembled to support sudden cardiac death research, including patients with sinus rhythm, pacing, and atrial fibrillation, all with sustained ventricular tachyarrhythmia.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Annotated Social Determinants of Health Dataset for Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes

summary: Manually annotated de-identified dataset of social determinants of health — social support, occupation, substance use — drawn from MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV discharge summaries and linked to adverse pregnancy outcomes, with model and preprocessing code.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Analysis of Clinical Text: Task 14 of SemEval 2015
summary: Dataset for the SemEval 2014 and 2015 Analysis of Clinical Text task: clinical text annotated for disorder recognition, mapping to UMLS Concept Unique Identifiers, and template filling of disorder attributes.

name: Surface electromyographic signals collected during long-lasting ground walking of young able-bodied subjects
population: 31 young (20 years < age < 30 years) able-bodied subjects; underweight, overweight, obese people and those with pathological conditions, joint pain, or prior orthopedic surgery excluded
summary: Long-lasting surface EMG signals from ten leg muscles recorded during barefoot ground walking of young able-bodied subjects, with synchronized footswitch and electrogoniometric data for spatial and temporal gait characterization.

name: SensSmartTech database of cardiovascular signals synchronously recorded by an electrocardiograph, phonocardiograph, photoplethysmograph and accelerometer
population: 32 healthy volunteers, 338 30-s recordings at rest and during relaxation after activity
summary: Multiparametric cardiovascular recordings taken at rest and after activity, with simultaneous ECG, phonocardiogram, photoplethysmogram and accelerometer channels, supporting study of cardio-respiratory and electro-mechanical coupling across a wide heart-rate range.

name: Squid Giant Axon Membrane Potential
population: North Atlantic squid (Loligo pealei) giant axons; 170 trials across 8 different axons
summary: Single-unit neuronal recordings from North Atlantic squid giant axons responding to stimulus currents, providing membrane potential and stimulus current traces across trials and axons.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: ShAReCLEF eHealth 2013: Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval for Clinical Care
summary: Task 1 and Task 2 data from the 2013 ShARe/CLEF eHealth shared task on clinical natural language processing and information retrieval: de-identified clinical narrative reports annotated for entities.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: ShAReCLEF eHealth Evaluation Lab 2014 (Task 2): Disorder Attributes in Clinical Reports
summary: Data for Task 2 of the 2014 ShARe/CLEF eHealth evaluation lab on disorder attributes in clinical reports, covering attribute normalization and cue identification over annotated discharge summaries.

name: Smart Health for Assessing the Risk of Events via ECG Database
population: 139 hypertensive patients recruited at the Centre of Hypertension of the University Hospital of Naples Federico II
summary: Nominal 24-hour ECG Holter recordings from hypertensive patients recruited at a hospital hypertension centre, collected to investigate whether heart rate variability analysis can identify those at higher risk of vascular events.

name: SHDB-AF: a Japanese Holter ECG database of atrial fibrillation
population: Patients with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation; the text states both 100 unique patients and 122 unique subjects, across 128 recordings, 98 of which carry beat-level annotations.
summary: Open Holter ECG database from Japan of subjects with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Most recordings include beat-level rhythm annotations made by a cardiology fellow; the rest are unannotated ECG traces.

name: Sleep Heart Health Study PSG Database
summary: Polysomnography data from the Sleep Heart Health Study, a prospective cohort study set up to investigate the relationship between sleep disordered breathing and cardiovascular disease.

access_notes: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
license: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0

name: Siena Scalp EEG Database

summary: Video-EEG recordings of epileptic patients from a neurology and neurophysiology unit, sampled at 512 Hz with 10-20 electrode placement; most recordings also include EKG. Diagnosis and seizure classification by an expert clinician.

name: Simulated Fetal Phonocardiograms
summary: A set of synthetic fetal phonocardiographic signals generated for different fetal states and recording conditions.

name: Simulated Obstructive Disease Respiratory Pressure and Flow
population: 20 healthy adults at the University of Canterbury, each completing a demographic questionnaire covering age, height, sex, and history of smoking, vaping, or asthma.
summary: Pressure, flow and volume recordings from healthy adults wearing a modular device that simulates obstructive pulmonary disease. Tests were run with CPAP at two PEEP settings and without CPAP, intended for validating respiratory computational models.

name: Simultaneous physiological measurements with five devices at different cognitive and physical loads
population: 13 adult and healthy subjects in a standardized experimental setup.
summary: Physiological recordings from healthy adults measured simultaneously by five devices during baseline, treadmill walking, a cognitive audio test and uphill walking. Includes raw files plus expert heart-beat annotations and phase markers.

name: Motion and heart rate from a wrist-worn wearable and labeled sleep from polysomnography
population: 31 subjects who wore an Apple Watch while undergoing polysomnography, recorded from June 2017 to March 2019.
summary: Acceleration and heart rate recorded from Apple Watches worn by people undergoing polysomnography, paired with sleep stages scored from the polysomnography. Collected at the University of Michigan.

access_notes: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
license: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0
name: Effect of 24-hour sleep deprivation on cerebral hemodynamics and cognitive performance
population: Ten young healthy adults (males, age of 27.6±3.7 years, one left-handed participant) recruited in 2018 at University of Oklahoma, Translational Geroscience Laboratory
summary: fNIRS recordings of frontal-lobe hemodynamics at rest and during a finger-tapping task, plus CANTAB cognitive testing, in young healthy adults before and after 24-hour sleep deprivation.

name: Sleep-EDF Database
summary: Whole-night polysomnographic sleep recordings including EEG, EOG, chin EMG, and event markers.

name: Sleep-EDF Database Expanded
summary: Expanded collection of 197 whole-night polysomnographic recordings with EEG, EOG, chin EMG and event markers, some with respiration and body temperature, plus manually scored hypnograms.

name: Sleep Bioradiolocation Database
summary: 32 records of non-contact sleep monitoring by bioradar, accompanied by sleep scoring based on polysomnography following American Academy of Sleep Medicine rules.

name: MIT-BIH Polysomnographic Database
population: 18 subjects monitored at Boston's Beth Israel Hospital Sleep Laboratory
summary: Multiple physiologic signals recorded during sleep in subjects evaluated for chronic obstructive sleep apnea and tested for the effects of constant positive airway pressure therapy.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: SNOMED CT Entity Linking Challenge
population: 272 discharge notes from the MIMIC-IV-Note dataset
summary: Discharge summaries from MIMIC-IV-Note annotated with SNOMED CT concepts by medical professionals, released as an entity linking challenge dataset with roughly 75,000 annotations across 272 discharge summaries.

name: STAFF III Database

summary: ECG recordings acquired during elective percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty procedures using single prolonged balloon inflation, capturing inter-patient variability in heart rhythm and waveform morphology.

name: MIT-BIH ST Change Database
summary: 28 ECG recordings of varying lengths, mostly from exercise stress tests showing transient ST depression; the last five are excerpts of long-term recordings showing ST elevation.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: National Institutes of Health Stroke Scale (NIHSS) Annotations for the MIMIC-III Database
population: Stroke cases with discharge summaries in the MIMIC-III database
summary: Annotated corpus of NIHSS scale items and their scores extracted from stroke patients' discharge summaries in MIMIC-III, manually annotated by two annotators with medical informatics backgrounds, to support clinical natural language processing research.

name: Shiraz University Fetal Heart Sounds Database
population: 109 pregnant women in single and twin pregnancies, aged 16 to 47 years
summary: Fetal and maternal phonocardiogram recordings captured with a digital stethoscope on the lower maternal abdomen from pregnant women with single and twin pregnancies at a hospital in Shiraz, Iran.

name: MIT-BIH Supraventricular Arrhythmia Database
summary: Half-hour ECG recordings chosen to supplement the supraventricular arrhythmia examples available in the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Swiss-Mammo: A physician-written, synthetic dataset of German mammography reports
summary: Synthetic German mammography reports manually written by a radiology resident and reviewed by a senior breast radiologist, each paired with an English translation and stratified across BI-RADS categories, as a benchmark for report information extraction.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Symile-MIMIC: a multimodal clinical dataset of chest X-rays, electrocardiograms, and blood labs from MIMIC-IV
