summary: Multimodal dataset derived from MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR pairing a chest X-ray, an electrocardiogram, and blood lab results per admission, with patient-disjoint splits, generation code, and a trained model checkpoint.

name: Synthetic Mention Corpora for Disease Entity Recognition and Normalization
summary: Corpus of synthetic disease mentions derived from the UMLS disorder group and generated with a fine-tuned language model, intended to support disease entity recognition and normalization in biomedical and clinical text.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Synthetic Acute Hypotension and Sepsis Datasets Based on MIMIC-III and Published as Part of the Health Gym Project
population: 3,910 patients with acute hypotension and 2,164 patients with sepsis in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
summary: Synthetic intensive care records of vital signs, laboratory results, fluid boluses and vasopressors for acute hypotension and sepsis cohorts, generated with adversarial networks from MIMIC-III for machine learning and teaching.

name: Post-Ictal Heart Rate Oscillations in Partial Epilepsy
population: a heterogeneous group of patients with partial epilepsy
summary: Database of post-ictal heart rate oscillations recorded in a heterogeneous group of patients with partial epilepsy.

name: Tai Chi, Physiological Complexity, and Healthy Aging - Gait
population: Healthy adults aged 50-79 in the Greater Boston area: 60 Tai Chi-naive subjects randomized to Tai Chi or usual care, plus 27 healthy Tai Chi experts
summary: Gait and muscle-activity recordings from older adults walking under normal and dual-task conditions, from a Tai Chi trial plus an observational group of experienced Tai Chi practitioners.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: TAME Pain: Trustworthy AssessMEnt of Pain from Speech and Audio for the Empowerment of Patients
population: Healthy individuals subjected to pain, under an approved University of Texas at Austin institutional review board protocol
summary: Audio recordings of speech from healthy participants undergoing pain, with every sentence annotated for background and foreground noise, speech errors, and non-speech vocal features, for pain-assessment research.

name: Tappy Keystroke Data
population: Over 200 subjects, with and without Parkinson's Disease (PD), typing on their own computers
summary: Unsupervised keystroke logs typed on participants' own computers over weeks or months, collected to study finger-movement changes in early Parkinson's disease.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Tasks 1 and 3 from Progress Note Understanding Suite of Tasks: SOAP Note Tagging and Problem List Summarization
population: Intensive Care Unit progress notes sourced from MIMIC-III
summary: Annotated intensive care progress notes supporting two tasks: tagging major SOAP sections and generating diagnosis summaries, aimed at clinical text understanding, reasoning, and generation.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: A Temporal Dataset for Respiratory Support in Critically Ill Patients
population: 50,920 adult ICU patients derived from MIMIC-IV v2.2
summary: Hourly ICU records over 90 days covering ventilation, labs, vital signs, vasopressors, and renal replacement therapy, plus static outcomes, built for time-series, survival, and sequential decision-making tasks.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: TherLid: A Thermometry Linked Dataset
population: Patients from MIMIC-IV, eICU-CRD-1 and eICU-CRD-2 contributing 13,251 temperature pairs with values between 30°C to 45°C
summary: Paired contact and infrared temperature measurements taken within one hour of each other, linked to demographics and hospital data, to study racial and ethnic disparities in infrared thermometry.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: TN-Mammo: A Multi-view Mammography Dataset for Breast Density Classification
population: 676 subjects with paired left and right breast views, from a Vietnamese mammogram dataset
summary: Mammograms with bilateral craniocaudal and mediolateral oblique views, each case labeled for breast density and orientation by two radiologists independently in a double-blind manner, for machine learning research.

name: Surrogate Data with Correlations, Trends, and Nonstationarities
summary: Surrogate signals generated for a study of a scaling analysis method that estimates long-range power-law correlation exponents in noisy signals; no patient or subject measurements are included.

name: tOLIet: Single-lead Thigh-based Electrocardiography Using Polimeric Dry Electrodes
population: 149 recordings from 86 individuals (50 females, 36 males), average age 31.73 ± 13.11 years, recruited via a hospital principal investigator and clinical consultations
summary: Single-lead thigh ECG recorded by electrodes embedded in a toilet seat, with reference signals from a standard 12-lead hospital ECG system, for research on "invisible" ECG cardiovascular assessment.

name: Term-Preterm EHG Database
population: Women attending regular check-ups at the University Medical Centre Ljubljana, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, recorded around the 22nd or 32nd week of gestation
summary: Electrohysterogram (uterine EMG) records collected during routine pregnancy check-ups at a university medical centre, taken around the 22nd or the 32nd week of gestation, for term versus preterm study.

name: Term-Preterm EHG DataSet with Tocogram
population: Pregnant women (26 four-signal records) and non-pregnant women (five records)
summary: Thirty-minute uterine electrohysterogram records with a simultaneously recorded external tocogram of mechanical uterine activity, covering both pregnant and non-pregnant women.

access_notes: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
license: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0
name: Treadmill Maximal Exercise Tests from the Exercise Physiology and Human Performance Lab of the University of Malaga
population: Amateur and professional athletes of ages ranging from 10 to 63 years old
summary: Cardiorespiratory measurements from 992 treadmill maximal graded exercise tests, recorded breath-to-breath with treadmill speed, plus participant age, height, weight and test temperature and humidity.

name: Effect of Deep Brain Stimulation on Parkinsonian Tremor
population: 16 subjects with Parkinson's disease (PD) who receive chronic high frequency electrical deep brain stimulation (DBS)
summary: Recordings of rest tremor velocity in the index finger of people with Parkinson's disease receiving chronic high frequency electrical deep brain stimulation.

name: T-Wave Alternans Challenge Database
population: Patients with myocardial infarctions, transient ischemia, ventricular tachyarrhythmias, and other risk factors for sudden cardiac death, plus healthy controls and synthetic cases
summary: One hundred multichannel ECG records assembled for the 2008 Computers in Cardiology Challenge, including patients at risk of sudden cardiac death, healthy controls, and synthetic cases with calibrated T-wave alternans.

name: St. Vincent's University Hospital / University College Dublin Sleep Apnea Database
population: 25 adult subjects with suspected sleep-disordered breathing
summary: Twenty-five full overnight polysomnograms recorded with simultaneous three-channel Holter ECG in adults with suspected sleep-disordered breathing. A revised version was posted in 2011.

name: Long-term Recordings of Gait Dynamics
population: Ten young, healthy men, mean age 21.7 years (range 18-29), with no history of any neuromuscular, respiratory or cardiovascular disorders and taking no medications
summary: Long-term recordings of stride interval fluctuations in healthy young men walking continuously on an obstacle-free oval path, measured with force-sensitive switches inside one shoe.

name: UniCA ElectroTastegram Database (PROP)
population: 39 healthy voluntary human subjects (16 males, 23 females), equally divided into the three PROP taster status classes
summary: Tongue biopotential recordings from healthy volunteers during stimulation with a PROP solution, with subjects divided across PROP taster status classes.

name: MIT-BIH Malignant Ventricular Ectopy Database
population: 22 subjects who experienced episodes of sustained ventricular tachycardia, ventricular flutter, and ventricular fibrillation
summary: Half-hour ECG recordings from subjects who experienced episodes of sustained ventricular tachycardia, ventricular flutter, and ventricular fibrillation.

name: Video Pulse Signals in Stationary and Motion Conditions
population: 15 healthy volunteers (12 men and 3 women between 23 and 35 years)
summary: Pulse signal recordings from healthy volunteers in stationary and motion conditions, each with a simultaneous face video and a finger pulse reference recording taken while seated.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: VinDr-CXR: An open dataset of chest X-rays with radiologist annotations
population: Patients whose chest X-ray scans were retrospectively collected from two major hospitals in Vietnam
summary: Chest X-ray images in DICOM format, retrospectively collected from two hospitals, annotated by radiologists with local bounding-box labels for abnormalities and global labels for suspected diseases, split into training and test sets.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: VinDr-Mammo: A large-scale benchmark dataset for computer-aided detection and diagnosis in full-field digital mammography
summary: Full-field digital mammography exams, each four-view and double read by mammographers, with BI-RADS cancer assessment and breast density plus bounding rectangles marking abnormalities needing further examination.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: VinDr-PCXR: An open, large-scale pediatric chest X-ray dataset for interpretation of common thoracic diseases
population: 9,125 pediatric chest X-ray studies retrospectively collected from a major pediatric hospital in Vietnam between 2020-2021
summary: Pediatric chest X-ray studies retrospectively collected from a pediatric hospital, each annotated by a radiologist for critical findings and diseases, with bounding boxes for abnormal findings and a training/test split.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: VinDr-SpineXR: A large annotated medical image dataset for spinal lesions detection and classification from radiographs
summary: Spine X-ray images from radiographic studies, each manually annotated by an experienced radiologist with types of abnormalities marked by bounding boxes, for lesion detection and classification.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Multimodal Physiological Monitoring During Virtual Reality Piloting Tasks
population: Participants who performed virtual flight tasks of varying difficulty in virtual reality
summary: Time-synchronized physiological, flight performance, and user interaction data from participants flying virtual reality instrument landing tasks at four difficulty levels, with data quality descriptions and starter code.

name: VitalDB, a high-fidelity multi-parameter vital signs database in surgical patients
population: 6,388 cases of surgical patients under anesthesia
summary: Open dataset of high-resolution intraoperative waveform and numeric monitoring tracks from surgical cases, plus perioperative clinical and time-series laboratory parameters, accessible via APIs and a Python library.

name: VitalDB Arrhythmia Database: An Anesthesiologist-Validated Large-Scale Intraoperative Arrhythmia Dataset with Beat and Rhythm Labels
summary: Annotated intraoperative ECG recordings from surgical patients, with heartbeats labeled across four beat types and ten rhythm categories, validated by five anesthesiologists with reported inter-rater agreement.

name: VOICED Database
population: 208 voice samples, from 150 pathological, and 58 healthy voices
summary: Database of voice samples from pathological and healthy voices.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Visual Question Answering evaluation dataset for MIMIC CXR
population: 40 test set cases and 23 validation set cases of the MIMIC CXR dataset
summary: Visual question answering evaluation set built on MIMIC CXR test and validation cases, with close-ended and open-ended questions and reference answers authored by a board-certified radiologist.

name: VTaC: A Benchmark Dataset of Ventricular Tachycardia Alarms from ICU Monitors
population: Patients monitored in ICUs at three major US hospitals
summary: Benchmark of waveform recordings around ventricular tachycardia alarms from ICU bedside monitors, each alarm labeled true or false by at least two expert annotators, spanning three hospitals and three monitor manufacturers.

name: Wilson Central Terminal ECG Database
summary: ECG database containing the Wilson Central Terminal voltage plus right arm, left arm and left leg potentials, unipolar chest leads, limb leads and precordial leads, in ten-second segments.

name: Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions
population: 36 healthy volunteers for stress sessions, 30 for aerobic exercise, and 31 for anaerobic exercise
summary: Wearable physiological recordings collected during a structured acute stress induction protocol with math and emotional tasks, and during aerobic and anaerobic stationary bike sessions, with self-reported stress levels.

name: A Wearable Exam Stress Dataset for Predicting Cognitive Performance in Real-World Settings
population: People recorded during three exam sessions (midterm 1, midterm 2 and finals)
summary: Wearable recordings of electrodermal activity, heart rate, blood volume pulse, skin temperature, inter beat interval and accelerometer data during three exam sessions, paired with the corresponding exam grades.

name: Wearable-based signals during physical exercises from patients with frailty after open-heart surgery
population: 80 elderly frailty patients, who entered a cardiac rehabilitation program after open-heart surgery
summary: Single-lead electrocardiogram and triaxial acceleration signals from elderly patients with frailty in cardiac rehabilitation after open-heart surgery, recorded during exercise tests, with demographic and clinical characteristics and exercise test results.

access_notes: PhysioNet Restricted Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: WiDS (Women in Data Science) Datathon 2020: ICU Mortality Prediction
summary: Datathon challenge dataset on ICU mortality prediction, drawn from the GOSSIS (Global Open Source Severity of Illness Score) initiative and hosted as a Kaggle competition.

name: Wrist PPG During Exercise
population: 8 volunteers during walking, running and bike riding
summary: Wrist photoplethysmogram recordings during walking, running and bike riding, with simultaneous accelerometer and gyroscope motion estimates for motion-artifact removal and a reference chest ECG for heart rate comparison.

access_notes: PhysioNet Credentialed Health Data Use Agreement 1.5.0
name: Establishment of a Chinese critical care database from electronic healthcare records in a tertiary care medical center
population: patients suffering from life-threatening complications and injuries
summary: Critical care database built from electronic healthcare records at a tertiary care medical center in China, covering routine intensive care data such as vital signs, ventilator waveforms, medical orders and laboratory results.

name: Data from 4D Lung Imaging of NSCLC Patients
population: 20 locally-advanced, non-small cell lung cancer patients
summary: Four-dimensional fan beam and cone beam CT images acquired during chemoradiotherapy of non-small cell lung cancer patients, sorted into breathing phases using an external respiratory surrogate, including weekly imaging during therapy.

name: Sorafenib Tosylate in Treating Patients With Desmoid Tumors or Aggressive Fibromatosis (A091105)
population: patients with desmoid tumors or aggressive fibromatosis
summary: Imaging and structure-set data from an Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology randomized phase III trial of sorafenib tosylate for desmoid tumors or aggressive fibromatosis, with patient-level data available separately.

name: Data from AAPM RT-MAC Grand Challenge 2019
population: 55 MRI cases, each from a single examination from a distinct patient; images and contours acquired from MD Anderson Cancer Center
summary: T2-weighted MRI cases acquired with a protocol for radiation treatment simulation, provided for a challenge competition, with training cases contoured for parotid glands, submandibular glands, and level 2 and level 3 lymph nodes.

name: Chemotherapy and Radiation Therapy in Treating Young Patients With Newly Diagnosed, Previously Untreated, High-Risk Medulloblastoma/PNET (ACNS0332)
population: young patients with newly diagnosed, previously untreated, high-risk medulloblastoma
summary: Data from a Children's Oncology Group randomized phase III trial comparing chemotherapy and radiation therapy regimens in young patients with newly diagnosed, previously untreated, high-risk medulloblastoma, covering brain, head and neck, and spine.

name: ACRIN 6698/I-SPY2 Breast DWI
population: women undergoing NAC for invasive breast cancer
summary: Multi-center trial imaging evaluating quantitative diffusion weighted imaging for breast cancer response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, with serial DWI, DCE and T2-weighted MRI and test/retest DWI in a subset.

name: ACRIN-Contralateral-Breast-MR (ACRIN 6667)
population: Women with a recent diagnosis of unilateral breast cancer and no abnormalities on mammographic and clinical examination of the contralateral breast, who underwent breast MRI.
summary: Breast imaging collection from ACRIN trial 6667, testing whether MRI improves on clinical breast examination and mammography for detecting contralateral breast cancer soon after a diagnosis of unilateral breast cancer.

name: Data from ACRIN-DSC-MR-Brain
population: Participants in the RTOG 0625/ACRIN 6677 trial with recurrent glioblastoma
summary: Imaging from a multicenter randomized phase II trial of bevacizumab with irinotecan or temozolomide in recurrent glioblastoma, investigating whether early posttreatment progression on FLAIR or postcontrast MRI predicts overall survival.

name: Data from ACRIN-FLT-Breast
population: Patients with pathologically confirmed breast cancer, candidates for primary systemic (neoadjuvant) therapy, with planned surgical resection of residual primary tumor after neoadjuvant therapy.
summary: PET imaging collection from ACRIN 6688 using [18F]-fluorothymidine to evaluate the relationship between FLT uptake parameters and pathologic complete response to neoadjuvant therapy in locally advanced breast cancer.

name: Data from ACRIN-FMISO-Brain
population: Participants with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme in the ACRIN 6684 multi-center clinical trial
summary: Multi-center trial data relating baseline FMISO PET uptake and MRI parameters to overall survival and progression in newly diagnosed glioblastoma, alongside performance status and pathological biomarker expression assays.

name: Data from the ACRIN 6685 Trial HNSCC-FDG-PET/CT
population: Head and neck cancer patients with a clinically N0 neck undergoing pathologic sampling of neck lymph nodes.
summary: Multicenter trial collection (ACRIN 6685) assessing the negative predictive value of FDG-PET/CT for the clinically N0 neck against pathologic lymph node sampling, and its potential to change neck treatment.

name: Data from the ACRIN 6668 Trial NSCLC-FDG-PET
population: Patients older than 18 years with AJCC-criteria clinical stage IIB/III non-small cell lung carcinoma planned for definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy (inoperable disease).
summary: Multicenter ACRIN 6668 trial collection with FDG-PET imaging before and after chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced non-small cell lung carcinoma, testing whether post-treatment standardized uptake value predicts long-term survival.

name: Voxel-level segmentation of pathologically-proven Adrenocortical carcinoma with Ki-67 expression (Adrenal-ACC-Ki67-Seg)
population: 53 confirmed ACC patients imaged between 2006 to 2018
summary: Retrospective contrast-enhanced CT studies of 53 confirmed adrenocortical carcinoma patients with clinical and pathological data including Ki-67 index, plus semi-automatic tumor segmentations refined by a radiologist for radiomic feature extraction.

name: Standard and Delayed Contrast-Enhanced MRI of Malignant and Benign Breast Lesions with Histological and Clinical Supporting Data (Advanced-MRI-Breast-Lesions)
population: Patients undergoing breast MRI at a single institution between 2018-2021; supporting data collected for 200 patients
summary: Single-institution retrospective collection of 632 breast MRI sessions from 2018-2021, including standard dynamic contrast-enhanced and delayed contrast series plus treatment response assessment maps, with supporting clinical and pathology data for 200 patients.

name: Risk-Based Therapy in Treating Younger Patients With Newly Diagnosed Liver Cancer (AHEP0731)
population: Younger patients with newly diagnosed liver cancer.
summary: Collection from Children's Oncology Group phase III trial AHEP0731 on risk-based therapy for younger patients with newly diagnosed liver cancer. Select patient-level data can be requested from the NCTN/NCORP Data Archive.

name: Combination Chemotherapy and Radiation Therapy in Treating Young Patients With Newly Diagnosed Hodgkin Lymphoma (AHOD0831)
population: Young patients with newly diagnosed Hodgkin lymphoma.
summary: Collection from Children's Oncology Group phase III trial AHOD0831 studying combination chemotherapy given with radiation therapy in young patients with newly diagnosed Hodgkin lymphoma, including radiotherapy structure data.

name: A Single-cell Morphological Dataset of Leukocytes from AML Patients and Non-malignant Controls
population: 100 patients diagnosed with Acute Myeloid Leukemia at Munich University Hospital between 2014 and 2017, and 100 patients without signs of hematological malignancy
summary: Expert-labeled single-cell images from peripheral blood smears of patients with acute myeloid leukemia and of patients without hematological malignancy, classified into a standard morphological scheme, with a subset re-annotated to quantify rater variability.

name: A morphological dataset of white blood cells from patients with four different genetic AML entities and non-malignant controls (AML-Cytomorphology_MLL_Helmholtz)
population: 242 peripheral blood smears from the Munich Leukemia Laboratory database from the years 2009 to 2020, covering four AML subtypes plus healthy stem cell donors
summary: Digitized peripheral blood smears providing individual white blood cell images from patients in four genetically defined AML subtypes and from a control group of healthy stem cell donors, drawn from a leukemia laboratory database.

name: Data from Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy Lung
population: 46 lung cases treated with anti-PD1 immunotherapy in 2016
summary: Imaging from 46 lung cases treated with anti-PD1 immunotherapy in 2016, each with two or more imaging timepoints.

name: Anti-PD-1 Immunotherapy Melanoma Dataset
population: 47 melanoma cases treated with anti-PD1 immunotherapy in 2016
summary: Imaging collection of melanoma cases treated with anti-PD1 immunotherapy, each case having two or more imaging timepoints. The imaging technique is not specified in the text.

name: Radiation Therapy, Amifostine, and Chemotherapy in Treating Young Patients With Newly Diagnosed Nasopharyngeal Cancer (ARAR0331)
population: Young patients with newly diagnosed nasopharyngeal cancer.
summary: Collection from Children's Oncology Group phase III trial ARAR0331 studying radiation therapy, amifostine, and chemotherapy in young patients with newly diagnosed nasopharyngeal cancer, including radiotherapy structure data.

name: Vincristine, Dactinomycin, and Doxorubicin With or Without Radiation Therapy or Observation Only in Treating Younger Patients Who Are Undergoing Surgery for Newly Diagnosed Stage I, Stage II, or Stage III Wilms' Tumor (AREN0532)
population: Younger patients undergoing surgery for newly diagnosed stage I, stage II, or stage III Wilms' tumor.
summary: Collection from Children's Oncology Group phase III trial AREN0532 studying vincristine, dactinomycin, and doxorubicin with or without radiation therapy or observation only in younger patients undergoing surgery for Wilms' tumor.

name: Combination Chemotherapy With or Without Radiation Therapy in Treating Young Patients With Newly Diagnosed Stage III or Stage IV Wilms Tumor (AREN0533)
population: Young patients with newly diagnosed stage III or stage IV Favorable Histology Wilms' tumor enrolled in COG trial NCT00379340 (AREN0533)
summary: Imaging and radiotherapy structure data from a Children's Oncology Group phase III trial of combination chemotherapy with or without radiation therapy for newly diagnosed stage III or IV favorable histology Wilms' tumor.

name: Combination Chemotherapy and Surgery in Treating Young Patients With Wilms Tumor (AREN0534)
population: Young patients with Wilms tumor, including children with bilateral Wilms tumor, enrolled in COG trial NCT00945009 (AREN0534)
summary: Data from a Children's Oncology Group phase III trial of combination chemotherapy and surgery in young patients with Wilms tumor, including bilateral disease treated with preoperative chemotherapy to preserve renal parenchyma.

name: Multiomics in primary and metastatic breast tumors from the AURORA US network finds microenvironment and epigenetic drivers of metastasis (AURORA-Metastatic-Breast-Multiomics)
population: 55 patients with 31 primary tissues and 102 metastases, including adjacent normal tissues
summary: Primary and metastatic breast tumor samples profiled by genome and exome sequencing, methylation arrays, and RNA sequencing, with H&E slides and HLA-A immunofluorescence; molecular data hosted in dbGaP and GEO.

name: Ultrasound data of a variety of liver masses
population: Patients with liver masses enrolled in two ongoing clinical trials of contrast-enhanced ultrasound
summary: B-mode and contrast-enhanced ultrasound images and cine-loops of liver masses from two ongoing clinical trials, with tissue pathology and cross-sectional imaging as reference standards and treatment response after transarterial chemoembolization for many cases.

conditions.label: metastatic breast cancer to the brain

name: MRI Dataset of Metastatic Breast Cancer to the Brain with Expert-reviewed Segmentations and Tumor-derived Radiomic Features (BCBM-RadioGenomics)
population: 165 patients with histologically confirmed metastatic breast cancer to the brain
summary: Brain MRIs from patients with metastatic breast cancer, skull-stripped and bias-corrected, with expert segmentations of tumor, resection cavity and nearby structures, radiomic features, and receptor status.

name: An Expert-Annotated Dataset of Bone Marrow Cytology in Hematologic Malignancies
population: 945 patients whose bone marrow smears reflect a variety of hematological diseases
summary: De-identified, expert-annotated cells from bone marrow smears stained with May-Grünwald-Giemsa/Pappenheim and imaged by brightfield microscopy, covering a range of hematological diseases seen at a laboratory specialized in leukemia diagnostics.

name: MR Imaging and Segmentations with Matched Brain Biopsy Pathology Slides from Patients with Brain Metastases from Primary Lung Cancer (Brain-Mets-Lung-MRI-Path-Segs)
population: 103 cases of patients with brain metastasis from primary lung cancer.
summary: Matched pre-operative brain MR imaging and whole slide pathology from biopsies in patients with brain metastasis from primary lung cancer, plus segmentations of contrast enhancement and FLAIR hyperintensity, radiomic features, and clinical information.

name: Brain Tumor Recurrence Prediction after Gamma Knife Radiotherapy from MRI and Related DICOM-RT: An Open Annotated Dataset and Baseline Algorithm (Brain-TR-GammaKnife)
population: 47 subjects with brain cancer treated with Gamma Knife radiotherapy; 244 annotated lesions
summary: Brain MRI with paired Gamma Knife radiotherapy planning, dose data and clinical information for tumor recurrence prediction, including annotated lesions with DICOM images, structure sets and follow-up data.

name: Data from Brain-Tumor-Progression
population: 20 subjects with primary newly diagnosed glioblastoma treated with surgery, chemo-radiation and adjuvant chemotherapy
summary: Two MRI exams per patient with glioblastoma, taken after chemo-radiation and at progression, including T1w, FLAIR, T2w, ADC, perfusion maps and binary tumor masks in DICOM.

name: Expanding the Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) data to include African Populations
population: 95 patients diagnosed with glioma and 51 patients diagnosed with other neoplasms of the brain, scanned pre-operatively at six diagnostic centers in Nigeria between January 2010 and December 2022.
summary: Curated African brain tumor MRI collection: retrospective pre-operative multiparametric scans from six Nigerian diagnostic centers, pre-processed with the BraTS protocol, with expert-annotated tumor subregion labels and a metadata file of study location and scanner type.

name: The Brain Tumor Segmentation in Pediatric Magnetic Resonance Imaging (BraTS-PEDs)
population: 457 pediatric patients with high-grade gliomas, primarily diffuse midline gliomas
summary: Multi-institutional pediatric brain tumor resource with multiparametric structural MRI, expert tumor segmentations, acquisition parameters, demographics and survival outcomes, aggregated from pediatric neuro-oncology consortia for segmentation research.

name: Breast Cancer Screening - Digital Breast Tomosynthesis (BCS-DBT)
population: Breast cancer screening exam cases, grouped as normal, actionable, biopsy-proven benign, and biopsy-proven cancer.
summary: Curated digital breast tomosynthesis screening dataset covering normal, actionable, biopsy-proven benign, and biopsy-proven cancer cases, shared as DICOM images with a spreadsheet of case groups and annotation boxes for machine learning development.

name: Data From BREAST-DIAGNOSIS
population: Cases that are high-risk normals, DCIS, fibroids and lobular carcinomas
summary: The Breast-Diagnosis collection contains cases that are high-risk normals, DCIS, fibroids and lobular carcinomas. Each case has 3 or more distinct MR pulse sequences from a Phillips 1.5 T (usual sequences are labeled T2, STIR and BLISS but may occasionally

name: A Curated Benchmark Dataset for Ultrasound Based Breast Lesion Analysis (Breast-Lesions-USG)
population: 256 patients with breast ultrasound scans; 266 benign and malignant lesions
summary: Breast ultrasound scans with radiologist freehand lesion annotations, BIRADS categories and descriptors, patient-level clinical data, and histopathological diagnosis where biopsy was performed, for lesion analysis benchmarking.

name: Single site breast DCE-MRI data and segmentations from patients undergoing neoadjuvant chemotherapy
population: 68 patients with stage II or III locally advanced breast cancer recruited; longitudinal DCE MRI studies of 64 patients available.
summary: Single-site pilot study of serial dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI during neoadjuvant chemotherapy, with segmentations. Longitudinal studies are available for 64 of the 68 recruited patients.

name: Burdenko's Glioblastoma Progression Dataset (Burdenko-GBM-Progression)
population: 180 patients with primary glioblastoma treated at the Burdenko National Medical Research Center of Neurosurgery between 2014 and 2020
summary: Imaging collection for glioblastoma patients covering radiotherapy planning MRI and CT with planning files, plus repeated follow-up MRI, with genetic mutation status and treatment response labels for a subset.

name: ALL Challenge dataset of ISBI 2019 (C-NMC 2019)
summary: Challenge dataset of microscopy cell images for classifying immature leukemic blasts versus normal cells in acute lymphoblastic leukemia, accompanied by a described deep learning classification framework.

name: C4KC KiTS Challenge Kidney Tumor Segmentation Dataset
population: 300 patients who underwent nephrectomy for kidney tumors at the center between 2010 and 2018; 210 selected at random as the challenge training set.
summary: KiTS19 challenge dataset of multi-phase contrast-enhanced CT, kidney and tumor segmentation masks, and clinical outcomes, supporting segmentation benchmarking and study of imaging biomarkers and tumor morphometry.

name: Rituximab and Combination Chemotherapy in Treating Patients With Diffuse Large B-Cell Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma (CALGB50303)
population: Patients with diffuse large B-cell non-Hodgkin's lymphoma enrolled in clinical trial NCT00118209 (CALGB 50303).
summary: Imaging collection from a randomized phase III National Cancer Institute clinical trial comparing rituximab given with two different combination chemotherapy regimens. Individual patient-level trial data can be requested from the NCTN/NCORP Data Archive.

name: Diagnostic Utility of Small Bowel Capsule Endoscopy in Small Bowel Neuroendocrine Tumors: Imaging and Correlation with Surgical Resection (Capsule-Endoscopy-SB-NET)
population: Derived from a prospective observational study of familial carcinoid tumor including 174 asymptomatic subjects; archived capsule endoscopy videos from 20 patients were reviewed.
summary: Curated de-identified images extracted from small bowel capsule endoscopy videos, with abnormalities identified by expert readers and correlated with surgical findings, intended for training and testing automated tumor detection.

name: CAnine CuTaneous Cancer Histology Dataset
population: 350 histologic samples of canine cutaneous tumors selected retrospectively from a veterinary pathology biopsy archive
summary: Whole slide images of hematoxylin and eosin stained canine skin tumor samples from surgical resections, with polygon annotations for non-neoplastic tissue classes and seven tumor classes.

name: Curated Breast Imaging Subset of Digital Database for Screening Mammography (CBIS-DDSM)
population: Normal, benign, and malignant screening mammography cases with verified pathology information, drawn from the DDSM database of 2,620 scanned film mammography studies and curated by a trained mammographer.
summary: Standardized, curated subset of the Digital Database for Screening Mammography, decompressed and converted to DICOM, with updated ROI segmentations, bounding boxes, and pathologic diagnosis for developing and testing mammography decision support systems.

name: Data From Credence Cartridge Radiomics Phantom CT Scans
population: No patients; the Credence Cartridge Radiomics phantom, with 10 cartridges of differing textures, scanned 17 times at four medical centers using each center's chest protocol.
summary: CT scans of a texture phantom acquired at four medical centers on scanners from four manufacturers, with cartridge contours as RT structure files, letting researchers evaluate radiomic texture feature robustness across scanners.

name: Credence Cartridge Radiomics Phantom CT Scans with Controlled Scanning Approach
population: Credence Cartridge Radiomic (CCR) texture phantom scanned on 4-8 CT scanners; no human participants.
summary: Collection of 251 CT scans of a Credence Cartridge Radiomic texture phantom acquired on multiple scanners under a controlled scanning approach, intended to identify robust radiomic features and establish ground truths.

name: Data from CT Phantom Scans for Head, Chest, and Controlled Protocols on 100 Scanners (CC-Radiomics-Phantom-3)
population: Phantom scans across 100 scanners using three protocols (head, chest, controlled); no human participants.
summary: Phantom CT scans collected on 100 scanners using three protocols, providing population data to quantify inter-scanner variability and test robustness of radiomics or other quantitative imaging signatures.

name: Cervical Cancer - Tumor Heterogeneity: Serial Functional and Molecular Imaging Across the Radiation Therapy Course in Advanced Cervical Cancer (CC-Tumor-Heterogeneity)
summary: Serial functional and molecular imaging of advanced cervical cancer before and during the radiation therapy course, to assess intra-tumoral heterogeneity of the tumor microenvironment spatially and longitudinally.

name: Categorized Digital Database for Low energy and Subtracted Contrast Enhanced Spectral Mammography images
population: Patients examined with contrast-enhanced spectral mammography after intravenous iodinated contrast injection
summary: Contrast-enhanced spectral mammography images acquired in craniocaudal and mediolateral oblique views at low and high energy, converted to JPEG, with full medical reports and manual segmentation annotations of abnormal findings.

name: Pre and post treatment MRI and radiotherapy plans of patients with glioblastoma: the CFB-GBM cohort (CFB-GBM)
population: 264 patients with glioblastoma involved in the clinical routine
summary: Pre- and post-treatment MRI from glioblastoma patients seen in clinical routine, with CT, radiotherapy dose and tumor delineation for some, plus clinical variables including survival, IDH status and MGMT methylation.

name: Cancer Moonshoot Biobank - Acute Myeloid Leukemia (CMB-AML)
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank acute myeloid leukemia cohort. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Invasive Breast Carcinoma Cancer Collection (CMB-BRCA)
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank invasive breast carcinoma cohort. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Colorectal Cancer Collection (CMB-CRC)
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank colorectal cancer cohort. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Gastroesophageal Cancer Collection (CMB-GEC)
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from a Cancer Moonshot Biobank cohort; the title names gastroesophageal cancer while the description names multiple myeloma. Genomic, phenotypic and clinical data hosted by dbGaP.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Lung Cancer Collection (CMB-LCA)
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank lung cancer cohort. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Melanoma Collection (CMB-MEL)
population: Subjects in NCI's Cancer Moonshot Biobank-Melanoma (CMB-MEL) cohort: patients receiving standard of care cancer treatment at multiple NCI Community Oncology Research Program (NCORP) sites, drawn from a biobank of at least 1000 patients across at least 10 cancer types.
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank melanoma cohort, covering CT, MR, PET and ultrasound. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Multiple Myeloma Collection (CMB-MML)
population: Subjects in NCI's Cancer Moonshot Biobank-Multiple Myeloma (CMB-MML) cohort: patients receiving standard of care cancer treatment at multiple NCI Community Oncology Research Program (NCORP) sites.
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank multiple myeloma cohort, including radiographs, CT, MR and PET. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Ovarian Carcinoma Cancer Collection (CMB-OV)
population: Subjects in NCI's Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Ovarian Carcinoma (CMB-OV) cohort: patients receiving standard of care cancer treatment at multiple NCI Community Oncology Research Program (NCORP) sites.
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank ovarian carcinoma cohort, with CT and MR studies. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: Cancer Moonshot Biobank - Prostate Cancer Collection (CMB-PCA)
population: Subjects in NCI's Cancer Moonshot Biobank-Prostate Cancer (CMB-PCA) cohort: patients receiving standard of care cancer treatment at multiple NCI Community Oncology Research Program (NCORP) sites.
summary: De-identified radiology and histopathology imaging from the Cancer Moonshot Biobank prostate cancer cohort, spanning CT, MR, nuclear medicine and PET. Associated genomic, phenotypic and clinical data are hosted by dbGaP and other NCI databases.

name: The Chinese Mammography Database (CMMD): An online mammography database with biopsy confirmed types for machine diagnosis of breast
population: 1,775 patients from China with benign or malignant breast disease who underwent mammography examination
summary: Mammography database built on 1,775 patients from China with benign or malignant breast disease, with biopsy confirmation and molecular subtype information, intended for computer-aided detection, diagnosis and image-based biomarker research.

name: Highly multiplexed spatially resolved immune cell atlas of hepatocellular carcinoma (CODEX imaging of HCC)
summary: Highly multiplexed, spatially resolved imaging of immune cells in hepatocellular carcinoma, describing the cellular composition and spatial organization of the tumor immune microenvironment.

name: Preoperative CT and Survival Data for Patients Undergoing Resection of Colorectal Liver Metastases (Colorectal-Liver-Metastases)
population: 197 patients with pathologically confirmed resected colorectal liver metastases and preoperative portal venous contrast-enhanced MDCT within 6 weeks of hepatic resection; those with 90-day mortality or under 24 months follow-up excluded.
summary: Preoperative contrast-enhanced CT images with DICOM segmentation objects and survival data from a single-institution consecutive series of patients who underwent resection of colorectal liver metastases, for quantitative image analysis.

name: Chest Imaging with Clinical and Genomic Correlates Representing a Rural COVID-19 Positive Population
population: Patients from a rural population in the southern United States who tested positive for COVID-19
summary: Radiographic and CT imaging from a rural US population testing positive for COVID-19, with limited clinical correlates including demographics, comorbidities, lab data and radiology findings, cross-linked to SARS-COV-2 cDNA sequence data.

name: Stony Brook University COVID-19 Positive Cases
population: covid19-positive patients admitted to the SBU hospital
summary: De-identified radiology imaging linked to clinical data for covid19-positive patients admitted to a university hospital. Clinical data covers diagnoses, procedures, lab tests and covid19-specific values, stored as csv files following the OMOP Common Data Model.

authors.name: National Cancer Institute Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC)

name: The Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium Acute Myeloid Leukemia Collection (CPTAC-AML)
