authors.name: National Cancer Institute Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium (CPTAC)

name: The Clinical Proteomic Tumor Analysis Consortium Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma Collection (CPTAC-UCEC)
population: Subjects from the CPTAC Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma cohort
summary: Radiology and pathology images from the CPTAC uterine corpus endometrial carcinoma cohort, released by The Cancer Imaging Archive so imaging phenotypes can be correlated with proteomic, genomic and clinical data.

name: High-dimensional imaging of colorectal carcinoma and other tumors with 50+ markers
population: 140 tissue regions from the tumor invasive front of 35 advanced-stage colorectal cancer (CRC) patients, selected from an initial cohort of 715 CRC patients
summary: Multiplexed CODEX protein imaging of tissue regions from the tumor invasive front of advanced-stage colorectal cancer patients, split between Crohn's-like reaction and diffuse inflammatory infiltration groups matched for age, sex and tumor characteristics.

name: Data From CT COLONOGRAPHY (ACRIN 6664)
population: Male and female outpatients, aged 50 years or older, scheduled for screening colonoscopy, who have not had a colonoscopy in the past five years.
summary: CT colonography imaging from the ACRIN 6664 screening trial, with spreadsheets describing polyps and their colon segment locations, released to support development of computer-aided polyp detection algorithms.

name: CT Images in COVID-19
population: 632 patients with COVID-19 infections, all with a positive RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2 obtained within 1 day of the initial CT
summary: Retrospective chest CT images, converted to NIfTI, from patients with RT-PCR-confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection imaged at the point of care in an outbreak setting; used for training classification models.

name: A new 2.5 D representation for lymph node detection in CT (CT Lymph Nodes)
population: Patients with mediastinal CT images (90 patients) and abdominal CT images (86 patients) labeled at the National Institutes of Health, Clinical Center.
summary: CT images of the mediastinum and abdomen with radiologist-marked lymph node positions, provided for developing and benchmarking computer-aided lymph node detection methods.

name: CT-ORG: A Dataset of CT Volumes With Multiple Organ Segmentations
population: Patients were included based on the presence of lesions in one or more of the labeled organs
summary: CT volumes with lung, bone, liver, kidney and bladder labeled in 3D, brain on some scans, spanning contrast and non-contrast, low- and high-dose acquisitions, split into training and testing sets.

name: Task-Based Anthropomorphic CT Phantom for Radiomics Stability and Discriminatory Power Analyses (CT-Phantom4Radiomics)
population: A 3D-printed radiopaque CT phantom developed using real patient data; no human participants.
summary: CT series of a 3D-printed anthropomorphic phantom built from real patient data, with annotated normal liver tissue and lesion types, used to assess radiomics feature stability across CT acquisition parameters.

name: CT Ventilation as a functional imaging modality for lung cancer radiotherapy (CT-vs-PET-Ventilation-Imaging)
population: 20 lung cancer patients who underwent exhale/inhale breath hold CT, free-breathing 4DCT and Galligas PET ventilation scans in a single session.
summary: Breath-hold CT, four-dimensional CT and Galligas PET ventilation scans acquired in one session on a combined PET/CT scanner, enabling comparison of CT-derived and PET ventilation imaging.

name: A Multi-Centric Anthropomorphic 3D CT Phantom-Based Benchmark Dataset for Harmonization (CT4Harmonization-Multicentric)
population: An anthropomorphic 3D-printed phantom scanned on 13 scanners from 4 manufacturers at 8 institutions; no human participants.
summary: Repeated CT scans of an anthropomorphic phantom acquired across multiple scanners, manufacturers and institutions with a harmonized protocol, plus a 3D-printed liver with annotated abnormal regions and segmentation masks.

name: Prediction of Sunitinib Efficacy using Computed Tomography in Patients with Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumors (CTpred-Sunitinib-panNET)
population: 38 patients with metastatic or locally advanced pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, contributing 171 lesions with pretreatment CT images.
summary: Pretreatment CT images and clinical variables from patients with pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, used to develop and validate CT value ratio and radiomics models predicting sunitinib treatment efficacy.

name: MR imaging of pediatric subjects with high-grade gliomas
population: Pediatric subjects with histologically approved high-grade glioma, including diffuse midline glioma and diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma, from Boston's Children Hospital and Dana-Farber Cancer Institute (n=61); infants under one month excluded.
summary: Retrospective multi-institutional collection of structural brain MRI (pre- and post-gadolinium T1, T2, T2-FLAIR) from pediatric patients with histologically confirmed high-grade glioma, forming a subset of a segmentation challenge dataset.

name: H&E and immunohistochemical stain images of 209 cases of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma linked with cytogenetic features and clinical outcomes
summary: Tissue microarray scans stained for H&E and for CD10, BCL6, MUM1, BCL2 and MYC, with pathologist-annotated regions, nucleus-level geometric features, survival and follow-up data, and clinical and cytogenetic variables.

name: Stanford DRO Toolkit: Digital Reference Objects for Standardization of Radiomic Features
summary: Sample collection of synthetic three-dimensional digital reference objects, defined mathematically and saved as DICOM, spanning ranges of size, shape, intensity, texture, and margin sharpness for standardizing quantitative imaging feature extraction pipelines.

name: Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance images of breast cancer patients with tumor locations
population: 922 patients with invasive breast cancer imaged on 1.5T or 3T scanners
summary: Dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI for 922 patients with invasive breast cancer, shared with demographic, clinical, pathology, treatment, outcome and genomic data plus 529 precomputed imaging features and tumor locations.

name: Abbreviated Breast MRI and Digital Tomosynthesis Mammography in Screening Women With Dense Breasts (EA1141)
population: Women with dense breasts enrolled in ECOG trial EA1141; 1,516 subjects randomized, imaging and clinical data from 500 released
summary: Imaging and clinical data released from a randomized phase II cooperative-group screening trial comparing abbreviated breast MRI with digital tomosynthesis mammography in women with dense breasts.

name: The MATCH Screening Trial: Targeted Therapy Directed by Genetic Testing in Treating Patients With Advanced Refractory Solid Tumors, Lymphomas, or Multiple Myeloma (EAY131)
population: "Unmatched" patients from the MATCH screening trial who did not meet criteria for the genetic sub-studies, with advanced refractory solid tumors, lymphomas, or multiple myeloma
summary: Imaging and clinical data from patients screened but unmatched for the genetic sub-studies of a phase II trial of genetic-testing-directed targeted therapy in advanced refractory solid tumors, lymphomas and multiple myeloma.

name: Expert Anal Cancer Consensus Staging (ExACt)
population: An expert panel of radiologists and radiation oncologists with expertise in anal cancer diagnosis and treatment, invited by the Anal Staging Subgroup of the International Rare Cancer Incentive
summary: Expert consensus staging work on pre-treatment pelvic imaging for anal cancer, aimed at standardizing tumour and nodal staging to guide radiotherapy planning, radiotherapy atlas development and clinical trial design.

name: A whole-body FDG-PET/CT dataset with manually annotated tumor lesions (FDG-PET-CT-Lesions)
population: 501 consecutive whole body FDG-PET/CT data sets of patients with malignant lymphoma, melanoma and NSCLC, plus 513 data sets without PET-positive malignant lesions, examined between 2014 and 2018 at the University Hospital Tübingen
summary: Whole-body FDG-PET/CT studies with manually annotated tumor lesions, acquired on a single scanner, covering patients with lymphoma, melanoma or non small cell lung cancer plus PET-negative controls, for machine learning development.

name: Gamma Knife MR/CT/RTSTRUCT Sets With Hippocampal Contours (GammaKnife-Hippocampal)
population: 390 patients who presented with vestibular schwannoma, trigeminal neuralgia or metastatic disease and were treated with Gamma Knife stereotactic radiosurgery
summary: MR, CT and RTSTRUCT sets with hippocampal contours from patients treated with Gamma Knife stereotactic radiosurgery; each patient ID carries a suffix marking the treatment indication.

name: GBM-DSC-MRI-DRO
summary: Digital reference object datasets for dynamic susceptibility contrast MRI, built from physiological and kinetic parameters, synthetic three-dimensional tissue structures and a validated signal model, to validate relative cerebral blood volume acquisition and analysis methods.

name: Glioma Image Segmentation for Radiotherapy: RT targets, barriers to cancer spread, and organs at risk (GLIS-RT)
population: 230 cases of glioblastoma and low-grade glioma patients treated with surgery and adjuvant radiotherapy at Massachusetts General Hospital
summary: Post-surgical brain MRI (contrast-enhanced 3D-T1 and T2 FLAIR) with radiotherapy planning CT, plus manually delineated gross and clinical target volumes; a subset adds delineations of anatomical barriers and organs at risk.

name: Multimodal Head and Neck cancer dataset (HANCOCK)
population: 763 patients with head and neck cancer, monocentric real-world data
summary: Monocentric multimodal head and neck cancer resource from 763 patients: demographic, pathological and blood data, surgery reports in German and English, HE-stained whole slide images, and stained tissue microarrays.

name: Multimodality annotated HCC cases with and without advanced imaging segmentation
population: 105 confirmed HCC patients who underwent TACE between 2002 and 2012 with an available treatment outcome
summary: Retrospective pre- and post-procedure CT studies of hepatocellular carcinoma patients treated with transarterial chemoembolization, with curated semiautomatic segmentations of liver, tumor and blood vessels plus treatment outcome data.

conditions.label: ductal carcinoma in situ with microinvasion (DCISM)

name: Multimodal imaging of ductal carcinoma in situ with microinvasion (HE-vs-MPM)
population: 12 breast cancer patients, including 10 cases of DCISM, 1 case of DCIS, and 1 case of invasive breast cancer
summary: H&E histopathology and CK5/6 immunohistochemical images of breast cancer slides, plus multiphoton images of suspicious microinvasive cancer nest regions, supporting diagnostic research on ductal carcinoma in situ with microinvasion.

name: Head-Neck Cetuximab
population: A subset of patients from the RTOG 0522/ACRIN 4500 randomized phase III trial in stage III and IV head and neck carcinomas who joined the imaging study
summary: Pre- and post-treatment FDG PET/CT scans with radiotherapy structures, doses and plans, from a subset of a randomized phase III trial of radiation and chemotherapy for stage III and IV head and neck carcinomas.

name: Data from Head-Neck-PET-CT
population: 300 patients from four institutions in Québec with histologically proven head-and-neck cancer, all with pre-treatment FDG-PET/CT scans; patients with recurrent disease, metastases at presentation, or palliative treatment were excluded
summary: FDG-PET/CT and radiotherapy planning CT imaging with radiotherapy contours from head-and-neck cancer patients treated at four institutions in Quebec, with follow-up for locoregional recurrence and distant metastases.

conditions.label: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC)

name: Data from HEAD-NECK-RADIOMICS-HN1
population: 137 head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) patients treated by radiotherapy
summary: Clinical data and pre-treatment CT scans with manually delineated gross tumor volumes from head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patients treated by radiotherapy; the H&N1 dataset of a published radiomics study.

name: Low-Dose CT Images of Healthy Cohort (Healthy-Total-Body-CTs)
population: Thirty healthy adult research participants, 18 years of age or older, able to provide informed written consent
summary: Low-dose whole-body CT images with automatically generated tissue segmentations from healthy adults imaged on a total-body PET/CT system at multiple timepoints after tracer injection, plus basic demographic and body measurements.

name: HER2 and trastuzumab treatment response H&E slides with tumor ROI annotations
population: Patients with HER2-positive breast cancer, including pre-treatment samples from HER2+ patients that subsequently received trastuzumab therapy
summary: Hematoxylin and eosin whole slide images with pathologist-annotated tumor regions of interest, used to train classifiers predicting HER2 status and trastuzumab treatment response in breast cancer.

name: Recurrent Breast Cancer: Histopathological and Hyperspectral Images Database (HistologyHSI-BC-Recurrence)
population: 47 patients diagnosed with breast tumors, of whom 22 had distant recurrence during the 10 years of follow-up after diagnosis
summary: Histopathological and hyperspectral images of primary breast tumor biopsies with clinical data, annotated by pathologists, labeled for distant recurrence over ten years of follow-up after diagnosis.

name: Hyperspectral Histological Images for Diagnosis of Human Glioblastoma (HistologyHSI-GB)
population: Patients with glioblastoma brain tumors, one histological slide per patient
summary: Annotated hyperspectral histological images of glioblastoma brain tumors captured at 20x magnification, labeled by histopathologists as glioblastoma or no tumor following the World Health Organization classification of nervous system tumors.

name: CT-RTSTRUCT-RTDOSE-RTPLAN Sets of Head and Neck Cancers Treated with Identical Prescriptions using IMRT: An Open Dataset for Deep Learning in Treatment Planning
population: 211 patients who presented with head and neck cancer and underwent external beam radiation therapy at a single institution
summary: Complete radiotherapy treatment data in DICOM format for head and neck cancer patients treated with identical IMRT prescriptions, including planning CT, expert-defined structures with standardized organ-at-risk names, plans, and dose.

authors.name: M.D. Anderson Cancer Center Head And Neck Quantitative Imaging Working Group

conditions.label: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC)

name: HNSCC
population: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) patients at MD Anderson Cancer Center
summary: Radiological imaging and associated data from head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patients at a cancer center, collected across two separate research projects with partially overlapping cohorts.

name: Head-and-neck squamous cell carcinoma patients with CT taken during pre-treatment, mid-treatment, and post-treatment Dataset (HNSCC-3DCT-RT)
population: 31 head-and-neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) patients treated with radiotherapy, scanned pre-treatment, mid-treatment, and post-treatment
summary: Serial fan-beam CT scans acquired before, during, and after radiotherapy in head-and-neck squamous cell carcinoma patients, with radiotherapy contours of anatomical structures plus treatment, toxicity, and patient detail records.

name: AI-ready re-stained and co-registered multiplex dataset for head-and-neck carcinoma (HNSCC-mIF-mIHC-comparison)
population: eight head-and-neck squamous cell carcinoma patients
summary: Digitized tumor sections from head-and-neck squamous cell carcinoma patients stained with multiplex immunofluorescence then restained with multiplex immunohistochemistry, co-registered and annotated for immune and tumor cells.

name: Digital pathological slides from Hungarian (Europe) colorectal cancer screening
population: Colorectal biopsy samples selected from the archives of the 2nd Department of Pathology of Semmelweis University, Budapest
summary: Whole-slide images of hematoxylin-eosin stained colorectal biopsies from a Hungarian colorectal cancer screening archive, scanned at 40x magnification in raw MIRAX format at a single center.

name: Canine glioma characterization project for ICDC (ICDC-Glioma) 01
population: 85 treatment-naive naturally-occurring canine glioma collected from 5 different veterinary institutions' patient populations
summary: Baseline pathologic, MRI and genomic features of treatment-naive naturally-occurring canine gliomas from several veterinary institutions, with harmonized neuropathology classification and exome, genome, RNAseq and methylation profiling.

name: Multi-center breast DCE-MRI data and segmentations from patients in the I-SPY 1/ACRIN 6657 trials
population: Patients with stage 2 or 3 breast cancer receiving neoadjuvant chemotherapy, enrolled on CALGB 150007 with T3 tumors measuring at least 3 cm; pregnant patients and those with ferromagnetic prostheses excluded
summary: Multi-center breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI with segmentations from a prospective trial testing whether MRI predicts response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy and risk of recurrence in breast cancer.

name: I-SPY 2 Breast Dynamic Contrast Enhanced MRI (I-SPY2 TRIAL)
population: Women aged ≥18 years diagnosed with locally advanced breast cancer (tumor size ≥2.5 cm) without distant metastasis, at high-risk for recurrence
summary: Serial breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI from an ongoing multi-center adaptive trial evaluating new agents in the neoadjuvant chemotherapy setting, using change in tumor volume to guide randomization.

name: Data from Ivy GAP
population: 399 scans for 41 brain tumor patients, including pre-surgery, post-surgery and follow up scans
summary: MRI and CT scans from brain tumor patients in the Ivy Glioblastoma Atlas Project, including pre-surgery, post-surgery, and follow-up imaging, linked to in situ hybridization, RNA sequencing, and annotated histological data.

name: Data from Lung CT Segmentation Challenge 2017 (LCTSC)
population: thoracic patients in radiation treatment planning
summary: Thoracic CT scans with organ-at-risk delineations released for a segmentation challenge, providing a platform to compare auto-segmentation algorithms used in radiation treatment planning.

name: Low Dose CT Image and Projection Data (LDCT-and-Projection-data)
population: De-identified patients undergoing non-contrast head CT, low-dose non-contrast chest screening, and contrast-enhanced abdominal CT exams
summary: Library of de-identified CT projection data in an open vendor-neutral DICOM-CT-PD format with reconstructed images, patient age and gender, and pathology annotation, covering head, chest and abdomen exams.

name: Data from LGG-1p19qDeletion
population: Subjects with Low Grade Gliomas (WHO grade II & III) who have biopsy proven 1p19q results
summary: Pre-operative MRI examinations of subjects with low grade gliomas, all with biopsy-proven 1p19q status determined by FISH, plus tumor segmentations on three axial slices in NIfTI format.

name: Data From LIDC-IDRI
population: Cases with clinical thoracic CT scans contributed by seven academic centers and eight medical imaging companies
summary: Diagnostic and lung cancer screening thoracic CT scans with lesion annotations from a two-phase blinded and unblinded read by four thoracic radiologists, for developing computer-assisted detection and diagnosis methods.

name: Fused Radiology-Pathology Lung (Lung-Fused-CT-Pathology)
population: Patients with small ground glass nodules with more than two histology slices per nodule; solid large nodules, too few histology slices, or slices with substantial artifacts were excluded.
summary: Lung CT with mapped histopathology for invasive adenocarcinoma in ground glass nodules. The mappings serve as ground truth of disease for studying imaging signatures. Collected and analyzed at Case Western Reserve University.

name: A Large-Scale CT and PET/CT Dataset for Lung Cancer Diagnosis
population: Patients with suspicion of lung cancer who underwent standard-of-care lung biopsy and PET/CT; images acquired retrospectively.
summary: CT and PET/CT DICOM images of lung cancer subjects with XML annotation files marking tumor location by bounding box. Subjects are grouped by tissue histopathological diagnosis into four carcinoma types.

name: Lung Phantom
population: FDA anthropomorphic thorax phantom with 12 phantom lesions of different sizes, shapes, and densities
summary: The FDA anthropomorphic thorax phantom with 12 phantom lesions of different sizes (10 and 20 mm in effective diameter), shapes (spherical, elliptical, lobulated, and spiculated), and densities (−630,−10, and +100 HU) was scanned at Columbia University Medical Center on a

name: Data from: Quantitative computed tomographic descriptors associate tumor shape complexity and intratumor heterogeneity with prognosis in lung adenocarcinoma
population: Patients with known tumors, imaged at diagnosis and prior to surgery, with sufficient follow-up.
summary: Small set of diagnostic contrast enhanced CT scans with known tumors, acquired retrospectively with variable slice thickness. Supports work relating tumor shape complexity and intratumor heterogeneity to prognosis in lung adenocarcinoma.

name: Mediastinal Lymph Node Quantification (LNQ): Segmentation of Heterogeneous CT Data
population: Patients whose chest CT scans were acquired during treatment for various cancer types
summary: Chest CT scans acquired during cancer treatment, with partially or fully annotated mediastinal lymph node segmentations and clinical data, curated for the LNQ2023 MICCAI challenge to develop segmentation tools from weakly annotated cases.

name: Segmentation and Classification of Grade I and II Meningiomas from Magnetic Resonance Imaging: An Open Annotated Dataset (Meningioma-SEG-CLASS)
population: 96 consecutive treatment naïve patients with intracranial meningiomas treated with surgical resection from 2010 to 2019
summary: Pre-operative T1, T1-contrast-enhanced, and T2-FLAIR MRI from treatment-naive patients with intracranial meningiomas who underwent surgical resection, with manual tumor contours and clinical information including confirmed grade and subtype.

name: MIDI-B-Curated-Test
summary: MIDI-B-Curated-Test: imaging collection on The Cancer Imaging Archive (MRI, PET, CT, xray, mammography, ultrasound; 322 subjects).

name: MIDI-B-Curated-Validation
summary: MIDI-B-Curated-Validation: imaging collection on The Cancer Imaging Archive (MRI, PET, CT, xray, mammography, ultrasound; 216 subjects).

name: MIDI-B-Synthetic-Test
summary: MIDI-B-Synthetic-Test: imaging collection on The Cancer Imaging Archive (MRI, PET, CT, xray, mammography, ultrasound; 322 subjects).

name: MIDI-B-Synthetic-Validation
summary: MIDI-B-Synthetic-Validation: imaging collection on The Cancer Imaging Archive (MRI, PET, CT, xray, mammography, ultrasound; 216 subjects).

name: Data in Support of the MIDI-B Challenge (MIDI-B-Synthetic-Validation, MIDI-B-Curated-Validation, MIDI-B-Synthetic-Test, MIDI-B-Curated-Test)
summary: Clinical DICOM images infused with synthetic PHI/PII plus a curated de-identified version, mapping files, answer keys and a validation script, used for the MIDI-B de-identification benchmark challenge.

name: Medical Imaging Data Resource Center - RSNA International COVID Radiology Database Release 1a - Chest CT Covid+ (MIDRC-RICORD-1a)
summary: Expert-annotated chest CT imaging from COVID-19 positive cases, created by the RSNA with the Society of Thoracic Radiology and published through MIDRC as an open research and educational resource for machine learning.

name: Medical Imaging Data Resource Center (MIDRC) - RSNA International COVID Open Research Database (RICORD) Release 1b - Chest CT Covid-
summary: Multi-institutional, multi-national expert-annotated chest CT collection for COVID-19, released freely as a research and educational resource and incorporated into the MIDRC repository.

name: Medical Imaging Data Resource Center (MIDRC) - RSNA International COVID Radiology Database (RICORD) Release 1c - Chest x-ray, Covid+ (MIDRC-RICORD-1C)
summary: Chest x-ray imaging from COVID-19 positive cases in the RSNA International COVID Radiology Database, published through MIDRC as an expert-annotated, freely available resource for machine learning research and education.

name: MiMM_SBILab Dataset: Microscopic Images of Multiple Myeloma
population: Patients diagnosed with multiple myeloma as per the standard guidelines
summary: Microscopic images of Jenner-Giemsa stained bone marrow aspirate slides from patients diagnosed with multiple myeloma, stain normalized and provided as an annotated set with plasma cells marked for segmentation.

name: TCIA Mouse-Astrocytoma Collection
population: Genetically engineered mouse models (GEMMs) of high grade astrocytoma in which RB, KRAS and/or PI3K signaling are perturbed
summary: MRI of genetically engineered mouse models of high grade astrocytoma, including anatomic T2 weighted and dynamic contrast enhanced sequences, used for qualitative and quantitative phenotypic characterization of genotypes and molecular subtypes.

name: TCIA Mouse-Mammary Collection
population: Genetically engineered mouse models (GEMMs) of breast cancer, focused on preinvasive ductal carcinoma in situ
summary: MRI of genetically engineered mouse models of breast cancer, emphasizing preinvasive ductal carcinoma in situ and how perturbed Rb, p53 and BRCA1 function influences development and progression into invasive disease.

conditions.label: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

name: Data from Synthetic and Phantom MR Images for Determining Deformable Image Registration Accuracy (MRI-DIR)
population: A porcine phantom imaged in four compressed positions, plus synthetic images derived from 28 head and neck squamous cell carcinoma patients with pre-, mid-, and post-radiotherapy MR scans
summary: Two image sets for evaluating deformable image registration accuracy: CT and T1/T2-weighted scans of a porcine phantom with implanted gold markers, and synthetic images derived from head and neck cancer patients.

name: University of Missouri Post-operative Glioma Dataset
population: 203 glioma patients with 617 different post-treatment MR time points
summary: Post-treatment MR imaging from glioma patients across multiple time points with tumor segmentations produced by a deep learning pipeline and validated by neuroradiologists, plus demographics, genomics, and treatment details.

name: Nascent prostate cancer heterogeneity drives evolution and resistance to intense hormonal therapy
population: Patients with intermediate or high risk prostate cancer treated with intense neoadjuvant therapy
summary: Targeted prostate biopsies and radical prostatectomy tissues from patients given intense neoadjuvant hormonal therapy, with scanned immunohistochemistry slides, RNA-seq expression, exome sequencing of microdissected tumor, and germline whole-genome data; therapy response known.

name: Data From NaF PROSTATE
population: Patients with prostate cancer, with suspected or known bone involvement
summary: F-18 NaF PET/CT images from patients with prostate cancer and suspected or known bone involvement, with detailed scanner and reconstruction parameters; some patients have repeat baseline studies and post-therapy follow-up imaging.

authors.name: National Lung Screening Trial Research Team

name: Data from the National Lung Screening Trial (NLST)
population: Persons at high risk for lung cancer enrolled from August 2002 through April 2004 at 33 U.S. medical centers and randomly assigned to annual low-dose CT or chest radiography screening
summary: Imaging from the National Lung Screening Trial, a randomized trial comparing low-dose CT with chest radiography for lung cancer screening; the dataset includes low-dose CT scans and digitized histopathology images from enrolled subjects.

name: Data From NRG-1308
population: Patients included in the NRG-1308 phase 3 randomized trial with inoperable stage II-IIIB NSLC
summary: Images acquired in preparation for NRG-1308, a phase 3 randomized trial comparing overall survival after photon versus proton chemoradiation therapy. Includes IMRT photon and proton scans.

conditions.label: Stage III Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

name: Data from NSCLC-Cetuximab
population: Patients with newly diagnosed stage III non-small cell lung cancer that cannot be removed by surgery
summary: Data from National Cancer Institute clinical trial NCT00533949 (RTOG-0617), testing high-dose or standard-dose radiation therapy and chemotherapy with or without cetuximab in unresectable stage III non-small cell lung cancer.

name: Data for NSCLC Radiogenomics Collection
population: Subjects in a Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) cohort, with tumor tissue surgically excised
summary: CT and PET/CT images from a non-small cell lung cancer cohort, with tumor segmentations, semantic annotations, gene mutation and RNA sequencing data from excised tumor tissue, and clinical data including survival outcomes.

name: Data From NSCLC-Radiomics
population: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients with pretreatment CT scans
summary: Pretreatment CT scans from non-small cell lung cancer patients with manual gross tumor volume delineation by a radiation oncologist and clinical outcome data; the Lung1 set used to build a prognostic radiomic signature.

name: Data From NSCLC-Radiomics-Genomics
population: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients that were treated with surgery
summary: Pretreatment CT scans, gene expression, and clinical data from non-small cell lung cancer patients treated with surgery; the Lung3 set used to investigate associations between radiomic imaging features and gene-expression profiles.

name: Data from NSCLC-Radiomics-Interobserver1
population: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) radiotherapy patients, most with pre-treatment CT scans
summary: Clinical data and CT from non-small cell lung cancer radiotherapy patients, with repeated blinded manual gross tumor volume delineations by five radiation oncologists and a second round using an autosegmentation tool with manual adjustment.

name: Data from Radiomic Biomarkers to Refine Risk Models for Distant Metastasis in Oropharyngeal Carcinoma
population: Patients with nonmetastatic HPV-related oropharyngeal cancer
summary: Imaging study examining whether quantitative imaging (radiomic) features of the primary tumor are associated with higher risk of distant metastasis in HPV-related oropharyngeal cancer, to refine risk models.

name: Osteosarcoma UT Southwestern/UT Dallas for Viable and Necrotic Tumor Assessment
population: Archival samples for 50 patients treated at Children's Medical Center, Dallas, between 1995 and 2015
summary: H&E stained osteosarcoma histology images labelled by pathologists as Non-Tumor, Viable Tumor or Necrosis. Consists of 1144 images of size 1024 X 1024 at 10X resolution, from archival patient samples.

name: A dataset of histopathological whole slide images for classification of Treatment effectiveness to ovarian cancer (Ovarian Bevacizumab Response)
population: 288 HGSOC patients whose slides came from the tissue bank of the Tri-Service General Hospital and the National Defense Medical Center, Taipei, Taiwan
summary: De-identified 288 H&E stained whole slide images from 288 HGSOC patients with clinical information, scanned at 20x, for classifying whether bevacizumab treatment was effective or invalid.

name: Data From Pancreas-CT
population: 53 male and 27 female subjects, ages 18 to 76 (mean 46.8 ± 16.7); seventeen are healthy kidney donors scanned prior to nephrectomy and the remaining 65 patients had neither major abdominal pathologies nor pancreatic cancer lesions.
summary: Abdominal contrast-enhanced CT scans of subjects without major abdominal pathology, including healthy kidney donors, with manual slice-by-slice pancreas segmentations produced by a medical student and verified by an experienced radiologist.

name: Breath-hold CT and cone-beam CT images with expert manual organ-at-risk segmentations from radiation treatments of locally advanced pancreatic cancer (Pancreatic-CT-CBCT-SEG)
population: 40 patients who received ablative radiation therapy for locally advanced pancreatic cancer at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, data obtained retrospectively with IRB approval.
summary: Breath-hold planning CT and cone-beam CT scans with expert manual organ-at-risk segmentations, collected to evaluate CT-to-CBCT deformable registration and auto-segmentation algorithms in pancreatic cancer radiation therapy.

name: 3D pathology of prostate biopsies with biochemical recurrence outcomes: raw H&E-analog datasets and image translation-assisted segmentation in 3D (ITAS3D) datasets (PCa_Bx_3Dpathology)
population: 50 patient cases with prostate biopsies and biochemical recurrence outcomes
summary: Raw and fused 3D open-top light-sheet microscope images of prostate biopsies with H&E-analog staining, synthetic CK8 immunofluorescence, 3D gland segmentation masks, cancer-enriched region coordinates, and clinical biochemical recurrence outcomes.

name: Imaging characterization of a metastatic patient derived model of adenocarcinoma pancreas: PDMR-292921-168-R
population: Mice carrying the adenocarcinoma pancreas patient derived xenograft 292921-168-R
summary: MR imaging characterization of a patient derived xenograft model of pancreatic adenocarcinoma that develops spontaneous lung metastases; tumors were resected in half the mice and allowed to grow in the others.

name: Imaging characterization of a metastatic patient derived model of melanoma: PDMR-425362-245-T
population: Mice carrying the melanoma patient derived xenograft 425362-245-T
summary: MR imaging characterization of a patient derived xenograft model of melanoma that develops spontaneous lung metastases; tumors were resected in half the mice and allowed to grow in the others.

name: Imaging characterization of a metastatic patient derived model of adenocarcinoma pancreas: (PDMR-521955-158-R4)
population: Mice carrying the adenocarcinoma pancreas patient derived xenograft 521955-158-R4
summary: MR imaging characterization of a patient derived xenograft model of pancreatic adenocarcinoma that develops spontaneous lung metastases; tumors were resected in half the mice and allowed to grow in the others.

name: Imaging tissue characterization of a patient derived xenograft model of adenocarcinoma pancreas: PDMR-833975-119-R
population: Mice carrying the patient derived xenograft model PDMR 833975-119-R of adenocarcinoma pancreas; tumors resected in half the animals
summary: Imaging characterization of a pancreatic adenocarcinoma patient-derived xenograft model in mice, with tumors resected in half the animals and grown until euthanasia in the rest; intended for training tissue-texture algorithms.

name: Imaging characterization of a metastatic patient derived model of adenocarcinoma colon: PDMR-997537-175-T
population: Mice carrying the metastatic patient derived xenograft model adenocarcinoma colon 997537-175-T
summary: Imaging characterization of a colon adenocarcinoma patient-derived xenograft model in mice that develops spontaneous lung metastases; tumors were resected in half the animals and allowed to grow in the others.

name: Imaging characterization of a metastatic patient derived model of bladder cancer: BL0293F (PDMR-BL0293-F563)
population: Mice carrying bladder xenograft BL0293, with and without resection of the xenograft, some receiving chemotherapy
summary: Imaging characterization of a bladder cancer patient-derived xenograft model in mice that develops spontaneous liver and bone metastases, imaged with non-contrast T2-weighted sequences, including animals given chemotherapy.

name: Serial Non-contrast Non-gated T2w MRI Datasets of Patient Derived Xenograft Cancer Models for Development of Tissue Characterization Algorithms (PDMR-Texture Analysis)
population: Mice carrying patient derived xenograft cancer models, imaged at multiple time points
summary: Serial non-contrast, non-gated T2-weighted MRI of patient-derived xenograft cancer models in mice imaged at multiple time points, released for developing tissue characterization algorithms such as neural networks and classifiers.

name: Pediatric Chest/Abdomen/Pelvic CT Exams with Expert Organ Contours (Pediatric-CT-SEG)
population: 359 pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis or abdomen-pelvis exams acquired from three CT scanners, representing random pediatric cases based upon routine clinical indications.
summary: Pediatric chest-abdomen-pelvis and abdomen-pelvis CT exams in DICOM format with expert organ contours, collected to support development of rapid, patient-specific CT organ dose estimation tools.

name: Pelvic Reference Data
population: 58 pelvic cases, each with a CT/CBCT image pair and an average of 154 (range: 91-212) selected landmark pairs.
summary: Purpose: Expert selected landmark points on clinical image pairs provide a basis for rigid registration validation. Using combinatorial rigid registration optimization (CORRO) we provide a statistically characterized reference data set for image registration of the pelvis by estimating the underlying

name: Data From Phantom FDA
population: An anthropomorphic thoracic phantom containing a vasculature insert on which synthetic nodules were inserted or attached; ten repeat scans per protocol and nodule layout.
summary: Repeat CT scans of an anthropomorphic thoracic phantom with synthetic nodules of known size and location, acquired across imaging protocols and nodule layouts to assess lung nodule size estimation methods.

name: Assessment of Residual Breast Cancer Cellularity after Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy using Digital Pathology
population: Patients with residual invasive breast cancer following neoadjuvant therapy who underwent breast resection
summary: Digitized histologic sections from breast resections in patients with residual invasive breast cancer after neoadjuvant therapy, plus clinical features, tumor cellularity and tumor bed annotations, and cell-level malignant, healthy, lymphocyte and other labels.

name: A Large Open Access Dataset of Brain Metastasis 3D Segmentations on MRI with Clinical and Imaging Feature Information
population: 200 patients with pathological or clinical diagnosis of metastases to the brain
summary: Pretreatment brain MRI (T1, T1 post-contrast, T2, FLAIR) for patients with brain metastases, with manual segmentation masks of edema, enhancing tumor and necrosis, plus a spreadsheet of clinical and imaging variables.

name: Data From Prostate-3T
summary: Transversal T2-weighted prostate MRI acquired at 3.0T with a pelvic phased-array coil for prostate cancer detection, contributed to TCIA as part of an ISBI challenge competition in 2013.

name: Stress-Testing Pelvic Autosegmentation Algorithms Using Anatomical Edge Cases (Prostate-Anatomical-Edge-Cases)
population: From 950 consecutive patients with prostate adenocarcinoma receiving definitive radiotherapy between 2011 and 2019, 112 patients with anatomic variations (edge cases) plus a separate cohort of 19 randomly selected "normal" cases.
summary: Simulation CT and MRI from prostate radiotherapy patients selected for anatomic variations such as hip arthroplasty, median lobe hypertrophy, or urinary catheters, with manual pelvic organ segmentations for stress-testing autosegmentation algorithms.

name: Data From PROSTATE-DIAGNOSIS
population: Prostate cancer patients imaged with combined surface and endorectal coil MRI
summary: Prostate cancer T1- and T2-weighted MRI acquired on a 1.5 T scanner with combined surface and endorectal coil, including dynamic contrast-enhanced images before, during and after gadolinium administration.

name: Fused Radiology-Pathology Prostate Dataset
population: Patients with a total of 35 prostate MRI studies and accompanying digitized histopathology images of corresponding radical prostatectomy specimens.
summary: Multiparametric prostate MRI paired with digitized whole-mount histopathology from radical prostatectomy specimens, co-registered so expert pathologist cancer annotations map disease extent onto the corresponding MRI scans.

name: Data From PROSTATE-MRI
population: Patients with biopsy confirmation of cancer who underwent a robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy
summary: Prostate MRI acquired at 3T with endorectal and phased array surface coils in patients with biopsy-confirmed cancer who underwent robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy, with specimens sectioned in the MRI plane.

name: Prostate MRI and Ultrasound With Pathology and Coordinates of Tracked Biopsy (Prostate-MRI-US-Biopsy)
population: Patients who underwent tracked prostate biopsy sessions using the Artemis biopsy system, most with MRI-ultrasound fusion targeting and systematic 12-core template sampling.
summary: Tracked prostate biopsy sessions fusing real-time transrectal ultrasound with preoperative multiparametric MRI. Targeted and systematic core locations were recorded relative to the ultrasound, with MRI biopsy coordinates and T2-weighted images provided.

name: SPIE-AAPM PROSTATEx Challenge Data
population: Human participants with prostate MRI studies used for the challenge
summary: Prostate MRI released for a grand challenge on quantitative image analysis methods for diagnostic classification of clinically significant prostate lesions, letting participants compare algorithms on the same data sets.

name: A DICOM dataset for evaluation of medical image de-identification (Pseudo-PHI-DICOM-Data)
summary: Open access or shared research data must comply with (HIPAA) patient privacy regulations. These regulations require the de-identification of datasets before they can be placed in the public domain. The process of image de-identification is time consuming, requires significant human

name: A whole-body PSMA-PET/CT dataset with manually annotated tumor lesions
population: 378 male patients with suspected or diagnosed prostate carcinoma
summary: Whole-body PSMA-PET/CT studies with all PSMA-avid tumor lesions manually segmented in 3D, plus anonymized DICOM files, segmentation masks and a table of acquisition and patient details.

name: Proteogenomic analysis of chemo-refractory high grade serous ovarian cancer (PTRC-HGSOC)
population: tumor biopsies from high grade serous ovarian cancer patients annotated for sensitivity to platinum chemotherapy
summary: Proteomic and genomic profiling of high grade serous ovarian cancer tumor biopsies from FFPE tissue, annotated for platinum chemotherapy sensitivity, with digitized H-stained bookend pathology slide images shared in this collection.

name: Data from QIBA CT-1C
population: Phantoms, rescanned across centers; no human participants.
summary: Phantom CT image sets contributed by RSNA's Quantitative Imaging Biomarker Alliance volumetric CT group. The same phantoms were rescanned across centers to isolate contributors to measurement variability for imaging profiles.

name: QIBA Anthropomorphic Abdominal Phantom CT Scans
population: Anthropomorphic abdominal phantoms with removable liver inserts; no human participants.
summary: CT scans of an anthropomorphic abdominal phantom with removable liver inserts holding synthetic lesions of varying size, shape, contrast and density, acquired on two multi-detector scanners across a range of abdominal protocols.

conditions.label: low and high grade glial brain lesions

name: Glioma DSC-MRI Perfusion Data with Standard Imaging and ROIs (QIN-BRAIN-DSC-MRI)
population: patients with low and high grade glial brain lesions
summary: MR images of low and high grade glial brain lesions, including post-contrast T1-weighted and dynamic susceptibility contrast perfusion volumes in DICOM, with binary regions of interest for lesion, arterial input function, white matter, cortex and whole brain.

name: Data From QIN-Breast
population: Breast cancer patients treated in the neoadjuvant setting, imaged at three time points before, during and after treatment.
summary: Longitudinal PET/CT, acquired prone to aid registration, together with quantitative MR images of breast cancer patients in the neoadjuvant setting, supporting development of quantitative imaging methods for early treatment assessment.

name: Data from QIN-BREAST-02
population: Adult (18+ years old) females diagnosed with invasive breast cancer, lesion size >1cm in longest dimension, undergoing neoadjuvant therapy
summary: Multi-site quantitative MRI study of adult women with invasive breast cancer undergoing neoadjuvant therapy, scanned before and after therapy initiation with a research protocol including diffusion, mapping and dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences.

name: Variations of dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging in evaluation of breast cancer therapy response: a multicenter data analysis challenge (QIN Breast DCE-MRI)
population: Patients in a longitudinal study of breast cancer response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, imaged at four treatment time points.
summary: Longitudinal breast dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI acquired before, during and after neoadjuvant chemotherapy, shared as a multicenter data analysis challenge for developing and validating quantitative imaging measures of treatment response.

name: Data From QIN GBM Treatment Response
population: patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma, scanned after surgery but prior to the start of therapy
summary: Repeat baseline multi-parametric brain MRI in newly diagnosed glioblastoma, acquired after surgery but before therapy. Includes structural sequences plus diffusion-weighted, dynamic contrast-enhanced and dynamic susceptibility contrast MRI to establish test-retest characteristics of derived parameters.

name: Data From QIN-HEADNECK
population: head and neck cancer patients, each with multiple PET/CT FDG scans before and after therapy
summary: Head and neck cancer patients with repeated FDG PET/CT scans acquired before and after therapy, plus follow-up scans where clinically indicated, provided to support Quantitative Imaging Network research.

name: Data From QIN LUNG CT
population: Patients diagnosed with Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer of mixed stage and histology who underwent surgical resection and had corresponding pre-surgery diagnostic CTs.
summary: Pre-surgery diagnostic CT scans with segmentations from patients diagnosed with non-small cell lung cancer of mixed stage and histology who underwent surgical resection at a single cancer center.

name: QIN PET Phantom
population: A body phantom with custom made spheres and ellipses, scanned at two sites; no human participants.
summary: PET scans of a body phantom fitted with custom spheres and ellipses, scanned at two sites on different scanners, used to assess variability of segmentation and derived quantitative results against known ground truth.

name: Data From QIN-PROSTATE-Repeatability
population: Patients with confirmed or suspected prostate cancer
summary: Multiparametric prostate MRI acquired in a test-retest setting to evaluate repeatability of MRI-based measurements for imaging biomarker development, with segmentation and structured report objects included.

name: QIN-SARCOMA
population: Soft-tissue sarcoma patients receiving preoperative chemoradiation treatment; not every patient completed all three MRI studies
summary: Longitudinal dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI of soft-tissue sarcoma patients imaged before treatment, after the first chemotherapy cycle, and after further chemoradiation before surgery, for developing quantitative imaging response methods.

authors.name: Princess Margaret Head And Neck Site Group

name: Computed Tomography Images from Large Head and Neck Cohort (RADCURE)
population: 3,346 head and neck cancer patients; median patient age is 63, with the final dataset including 80% males
summary: Head and neck cancer CT scans collected clinically for radiation therapy planning, with normal and non-normal tissue contours reviewed at quality assurance rounds, linked to demographic, clinical, treatment and follow-up data.

name: Data From REMBRANDT
population: glioma specimens from the Glioma Molecular Diagnostic Initiative; pre-surgical MR images from 130 REMBRANDT patients
summary: Repository linking clinical information with genomic characterization of glioma specimens, including gene expression and copy number arrays and clinical phenotype data. This image collection adds pre-surgical multi-sequence brain MR images for a subset of patients.

name: The Brain Resection Multimodal Imaging Database (ReMIND)
population: 114 consecutive patients who were surgically treated with image-guided tumor resection in the AMIGO Suite at the Brigham and Women's Hospital
summary: Pre- and intra-operative imaging from consecutive patients treated with image-guided brain tumor resection: preoperative MRI, 3D intraoperative ultrasound, and intraoperative MRI, plus segmentations of tumor, cerebrum, prior resection cavity, and residual tumor.

name: The Río Hortega University Hospital Glioblastoma dataset: a comprehensive collection of preoperative, early postoperative and recurrence MRI scans (RHUH-GBM)
population: 40 patients who underwent surgery with a pathologically confirmed diagnosis of WHO grade 4 astrocytoma at the Río Hortega University Hospital
summary: Preoperative, early postoperative and recurrence MRI studies from surgically treated grade 4 astrocytoma patients, preprocessed with CaPTk following the BraTS pipeline, with expert-corrected segmentations of enhancing tumor, necrosis and peritumoral region, plus clinical and pathological information.

name: RIDER Breast MRI
population: Primary breast cancer patients measured in response to onset of neoadjuvant chemotherapy from interval exams separated by only 8-11 days
summary: Breast MRI dataset applying functional diffusion or parametric response mapping to measure apparent diffusion coefficient changes in primary breast cancer patients from interval exams after starting neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

name: Coffee-break lung CT collection with scan images reconstructed at multiple imaging parameters
population: Thirty-two NSCLC patients receiving systemic therapy, each of whom underwent two CT scans of the chest within 15 minutes using the same imaging protocol
summary: Same-day repeat chest CT scans in non-small cell lung cancer patients on systemic therapy, each scan reconstructed at multiple slice thicknesses and algorithms, to evaluate variability of tumor size measurements.

name: Data From RIDER Lung PET-CT
population: Lung cancer patients plus phantom studies
summary: De-identified serial PET/CT phantom and lung cancer patient imaging shared to support testing of response-assessment algorithms and to quantify sources of variance in serial PET/CT measurements unrelated to treatment response.

name: Data From RIDER_NEURO_MRI
summary: Repeat brain MRI of patients with recurrent glioblastoma scanned about two days apart, including dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI, T1 mapping, diffusion tensor imaging, and contrast-enhanced 3D FLASH sequences.

name: RIDER PHANTOM MRI
population: Phantom studies only; no human participants
summary: Repeat MRI phantom studies using a EuroSpin II test object with doped gel tubes, acquired on several 1.5T and 3.0T scanners with different gradient subsystems using an eight-channel head coil.

name: Data From RIDER PHANTOM PET-CT
population: Phantom scans at various sites; no human participants
summary: Repeat PET/CT phantom scans collected at multiple sites to assess uniformity of clinical imaging instrumentation, machine acquisition, analytic reproducibility and image processing, using a modified NEMA NU-2 image quality phantom.

name: RIDER Pilot
summary: Longitudinal X-ray CT imaging collected to monitor response to drug or radiation therapy, from M.D. Anderson Cancer Center and LIDC academic sites. Much of the data is unannotated; only the QIBA-VolCT-NoChange-1B subset is hosted here.

name: The Head and Neck Lymph Nodes Dataset, Definitive, Non-contrast (RPA-Head-and-Neck-Lymph-Nodes)
population: 47 (46 unique) patients who retrospectively received head and neck radiotherapy at MD Anderson Cancer Center, all receiving definitive therapy
summary: Non-contrast simulation CT scans with clinical segmentations of head and neck lymph node levels, curated to train and benchmark auto-contouring models for radiotherapy treatment planning in the Radiation Planning Assistant.

name: A Randomized Phase III Study Comparing Carboplatin/Paclitaxel or Carboplatin/Paclitaxel/Bevacizumab With or Without Concurrent Cetuximab in Patients With Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (S0819)
population: patients with stage IV or recurrent non-small cell lung cancer
summary: Data from a randomized phase III SWOG trial of carboplatin and paclitaxel with or without bevacizumab and/or cetuximab in advanced non-small cell lung cancer, including radiotherapy structure sets and selected patient-level data.

name: Breast Metastases to Axillary Lymph Nodes
population: 78 patients with axillary lymph node specimens; metastatic breast carcinoma present in slides from 27 patients
summary: Whole slide images of H&E stained axillary lymph node specimens with per-slide positive or negative labels taken from pathology reports, intended for comparing breast cancer metastasis detection algorithms.

name: SN-CanData: White Blood Cancer Dataset of B-ALL and MM for Stain Normalization
population: Patients diagnosed with B-lineage acute lymphoid leukemia and multiple myeloma
summary: Microscopic images of bone marrow aspirate slides stained with Jenner-Giemsa and H&E, captured at 1000x magnification, assembled to test stain normalization methods for white blood cancers.

name: A radiomics model from joint FDG-PET and MRI texture features for the prediction of lung metastases in soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities
population: a cohort of 51 patients with histologically proven soft-tissue sarcomas (STSs) of the extremities; patients with metastatic and/or recurrent STSs at presentation were excluded
summary: Pre-treatment FDG-PET/CT and MRI scans from a retrospectively evaluated cohort of patients with histologically proven soft-tissue sarcomas of the extremities, used to build a radiomics model predicting lung metastases.

authors.name: Armato III, Samuel G.; Hadjiiski, Lubomir; Tourassi, Georgia D.; Drukker, Karen; Giger, Maryellen L.; Li, Feng; Redmond, George; Farahani, Keyvan; Kirby, Justin S.; Clarke, Laurence P.

name: SPIE-AAPM-NCI Lung Nodule Classification Challenge Dataset
population: scans with malignant nodules and benign nodules used as calibration and test datasets for the LUNGx Challenge
summary: Contrast-enhanced CT scans with nodule locations and truth labels, released for the SPIE-AAPM-NCI LUNGx grand challenge on diagnostic classification of malignant and benign lung nodules, split into calibration and test sets.

name: Segmentation of spinal multiple myeloma lesions in dual-energy CT (Spinal-Multiple-Myeloma-SEG)
population: 67 patients diagnosed with multiple myeloma (mean age 66 years, range 48–85; 36% female)
summary: Dual-energy low-dose CT of patients with multiple myeloma, including conventional, virtual monoenergetic and calcium-suppressed images, segmentation masks of vertebrae and spinal myeloma lesions, plus demographic and disease-progression clinical data.

name: Spine metastatic bone cancer: pre and post radiotherapy CT (Spine-Mets-CT-SEG)
population: patients with a large range of primary cancers and corresponding bone metastatic lesions obtained for patients with metastatic spine disease
summary: Longitudinal CT scans before and after radiotherapy in patients with metastatic spine disease from varied primary cancers, with demographic data, lesion and fracture annotations, and manual and semi-automated vertebral segmentation labels.

name: Abdominal or pelvic enhanced CT images within 10 days before surgery of 230 patients with stage II colorectal cancer
population: 230 patients with stage II colorectal cancer (CRC) who underwent radical surgery, excluding those with preoperative neoadjuvant treatment, concurrent other tumors, or death within 1 month after surgery
summary: Preoperative contrast-enhanced abdominal or pelvic CT acquired within 10 days before radical surgery in patients with histologically confirmed stage II colorectal cancer, with stated inclusion and exclusion criteria and documented scanner and contrast protocols.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Urothelial Bladder Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-BLCA)
summary: Radiology images of bladder cancer patients from The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons. Images mostly acquired during routine care, with heterogeneous scanners and protocols.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Breast Invasive Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-BRCA)
summary: Breast imaging from patients in The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons, supporting genotype-phenotype and outcome correlation studies. Images largely from routine care.

conditions.label: Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma and Endocervical Adenocarcinoma Collection (TCGA-CESC)
summary: Cervical MR imaging from patients in The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data held in the Genomic Data Commons. Acquisition protocols and scanners are heterogeneous.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Colon Adenocarcinoma Collection (TCGA-COAD)
summary: Colon imaging from patients in The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons. Most images were acquired as part of routine care.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Esophageal Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-ESCA)
summary: Esophageal CT imaging from patients in The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons. Scanners and acquisition protocols vary across contributing sites.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Glioblastoma Multiforme Collection (TCGA-GBM)
population: Subjects from The Cancer Genome Atlas glioblastoma multiforme collection, with tissues collected from many sites all over the world
summary: Radiological images matched by patient identifier to The Cancer Genome Atlas glioblastoma subjects, letting researchers link tissue genotype, radiological phenotype, and outcomes. Images are heterogeneous, mostly acquired during routine care.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Head-Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-HNSC)
population: Subjects from The Cancer Genome Atlas head-neck squamous cell carcinoma collection, with tissues collected from many sites all over the world
summary: Radiological images matched by patient identifier to The Cancer Genome Atlas head and neck squamous cell carcinoma subjects, supporting study of links between genotype, radiological phenotype, and patient outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Kidney Chromophobe Collection (TCGA-KICH)
summary: Kidney imaging from chromophobe renal cell carcinoma patients in The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons. Images mostly from routine care.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-KIRC)
summary: Kidney imaging from clear cell renal carcinoma patients in The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons, enabling genotype-phenotype and outcome studies.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Cervical Kidney Renal Papillary Cell Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-KIRP)
summary: Kidney imaging from papillary renal cell carcinoma patients in The Cancer Genome Atlas, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons. Scanners and protocols are heterogeneous.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Low Grade Glioma Collection (TCGA-LGG)
population: Subjects from The Cancer Genome Atlas low grade glioma collection, with tissues collected from many sites all over the world
summary: Radiological images matched by patient identifier to The Cancer Genome Atlas low grade glioma subjects, supporting study of links between tissue genotype, radiological phenotype, and patient outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Liver Hepatocellular Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-LIHC)
summary: Radiology images of liver hepatocellular carcinoma patients, matched by patient identifier to TCGA clinical, genetic and pathological data, so genotype can be compared with radiological phenotype and outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Lung Adenocarcinoma Collection (TCGA-LUAD)
summary: Radiology images of lung adenocarcinoma patients, matched by patient identifier to TCGA clinical, genetic and pathological data, supporting study of links between genotype, radiological phenotype and outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Lung Squamous Cell Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-LUSC)
summary: Radiology images of lung squamous cell carcinoma patients, matched by patient identifier to TCGA clinical, genetic and pathological data for correlating genotype, radiological phenotype and patient outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Ovarian Cancer Collection (TCGA-OV)
summary: Radiology images of ovarian cancer patients, matched by patient identifier to TCGA clinical, genetic and pathological data, so researchers can relate genotype to radiological phenotype and outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Prostate Adenocarcinoma Collection (TCGA-PRAD)
summary: Radiology images of prostate adenocarcinoma patients, matched by patient identifier to TCGA clinical, genetic and pathological data for studying genotype, radiological phenotype and outcome relationships.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Rectum Adenocarcinoma Collection (TCGA-READ)
summary: Radiology images of rectum adenocarcinoma patients, matched by patient identifier to TCGA clinical, genetic and pathological data, enabling comparison of genotype with radiological phenotype and outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Sarcoma Collection (TCGA-SARC)
summary: The Cancer Genome Atlas Sarcoma (TCGA-SARC) data collection is part of a larger effort to build a research community focused on connecting cancer phenotypes to genotypes by providing clinical images matched to subjects from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA). Clinical,

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Stomach Adenocarcinoma Collection (TCGA-STAD)
summary: Radiology images of stomach adenocarcinoma patients, matched by patient identifier to TCGA clinical, genetic and pathological data, supporting study of genotype, radiological phenotype and outcomes.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Thyroid Cancer Collection (TCGA-THCA)
population: Subjects from The Cancer Genome Atlas whose tissues were collected from many sites all over the world; images mostly acquired as part of routine care.
summary: Radiological images of thyroid cancer patients, matched by patient identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data held in the Genomic Data Commons, enabling genotype-phenotype-outcome studies.

name: The Cancer Genome Atlas Uterine Corpus Endometrial Carcinoma Collection (TCGA-UCEC)
population: Subjects from The Cancer Genome Atlas whose tissues were collected from many sites all over the world; images mostly acquired as part of routine care.
summary: Abdomen and uterus imaging of endometrial carcinoma patients, matched by identifier to clinical, genetic and pathological data in the Genomic Data Commons for genotype-phenotype-outcome research.

name: High Grade Serous Carcinoma precursor lesion digital slide images (TP53-Precursor-Lesions)
population: 242 women over the age of 50 years old who had their fallopian tubes removed during a benign gynecologic procedure; 70 with at least 5 years of oral contraceptive use, 172 without
summary: Digital slide images of fallopian tube p53 signatures and precursor lesions of high grade serous cancer, from a retrospective study comparing long-term oral contraceptive users with non-users.

name: The University of California San Diego annotated post-treatment high-grade glioma multimodal MRI dataset (UCSD-PTGBM)
population: 243 timepoints from 178 subjects (mean age 56 +/- 13 years [std], 116 men, 62 women) with histopathologically-proven high-grade gliomas
summary: Post-operative brain MRI from patients with high-grade glioma, imaged on 3 Tesla scanners with 3D, diffusion and perfusion sequences, plus tumor segmentations, IDH and MGMT status, and survival information.

name: The University of California San Diego Longitudinal Vestibular Schwannoma Dataset (UCSD-VS-Longitudinal)
population: 191 subjects diagnosed with sporadic VS and a total of 570 MRI timepoints
summary: Longitudinal multimodal MRI surveillance of sporadic vestibular schwannoma, with T1-pre, T1-post and T2 sequences, voxelwise tumor segmentations, growth classification, and demographic and treatment information at each timepoint.

name: The University of California San Francisco Preoperative Diffuse Glioma MRI (UCSF-PDGM)
population: 501 patients with histopathologically-proven World Health Organization (WHO) grade 2-4 diffuse gliomas
summary: Preoperative brain MRI from patients with diffuse glioma, acquired with a standardized 3T protocol including diffusion and arterial spin labeling perfusion, with IDH and MGMT status and basic clinical details.

name: Multi-parametric magnetic resonance imaging (mpMRI) scans for de novo Glioblastoma (GBM) patients from the University of Pennsylvania Health System (UPENN-GBM)
population: De novo glioblastoma patients from the Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania
summary: Multi-parametric brain MRI of glioblastoma patients with demographics, outcomes, expert-corrected tumor and whole-brain segmentation labels, and extracted radiomic features in co-registered NIfTI volumes.

name: The University of Texas Southwestern Glioma MRI dataset with molecular marker characterization and segmentations (UTSW-Glioma)
population: 625 patients treated at UTSW between 2006 and 2023
summary: Curated brain tumor dataset with four MRI contrasts per patient, demographics, molecular markers and multi-label tumor segmentations, intended for studying MRI-genetic relationships and benchmarking deep learning models.

authors.name: The Research for Precision Oncology Program  and the Applied Proteogenomics Organizational Learning and Outcomes (APOLLO) Research Network

name: VA Research Precision Oncology Program - APOLLO (VAREPOP-APOLLO)
population: Veterans diagnosed with cancer who had genomic analyses performed on their tumor tissue as part of standard of care; all participants consented and signed HIPAA authorization.
summary: Multi-modality imaging across many body regions for a Veterans cancer cohort, collected alongside demographics, comorbidities, genomic analysis, treatments, medications, lab values and outcomes under the RePOP program.

name: Segmentation of Vestibular Schwannoma from Magnetic Resonance Imaging: An Annotated Multi-Center Routine Clinical Dataset (Vestibular-Schwannoma-MC-RC)
population: 160 patients with a single sporadic Vestibular Schwannoma referred from 10 medical sites and consecutively seen at a single center, with 428 timepoints and 487 3D-images.
summary: Routine clinical MRI from multiple scanners and vendors with manual expert-validated segmentations of vestibular schwannoma, including intrameatal and extrameatal components, across repeated timepoints for automatic surveillance research.

institutions.name: King's College Hospital NHS Foundation Trust

name: Deep Learning Consensus-based Annotation of Vestibular Schwannoma from Magnetic Resonance Imaging: An Annotated Multi-Center Routine Clinical Dataset (Vestibular-Schwannoma-MC-RC 2)
population: 190 adult patients with unilateral vestibular schwannoma (VS), referred to King's College Hospital, London, UK; patients with neurofibromatosis type 2 (NF2) were excluded
summary: Multi-center routine clinical MRI of adults with unilateral vestibular schwannoma, with longitudinal scans, consensus deep-learning-derived tumor segmentations, demographics and clinical decisions, supporting surveillance, segmentation and growth modeling research.

name: Segmentation of Vestibular Schwannoma from Magnetic Resonance Imaging: An Open Annotated Dataset and Baseline Algorithm (Vestibular-Schwannoma-SEG)
population: 242 consecutive patients with vestibular schwannoma undergoing Gamma Knife stereotactic radiosurgery
summary: Labelled contrast-enhanced T1 and high-resolution T2 brain MRI from vestibular schwannoma patients treated with Gamma Knife stereotactic radiosurgery, each paired with radiation therapy dose, structure and plan data.

name: Data from THE VICTRE TRIAL: OPEN-SOURCE, IN-SILICO CLINICAL TRIAL FOR EVALUATING DIGITAL BREAST TOMOSYNTHESIS (VICTRE)
population: Simulated subjects with breast sizes and radiographic densities representative of a screening population and compressed thicknesses from 3.5 to 6 cm
summary: In-silico clinical trial data: simulated breast phantoms imaged on virtual digital mammography and tomosynthesis systems, read by a computational reader, comparing lesion-detection performance between the two modalities.

name: Yale longitudinal dataset of brain metastases on MRI with associated clinical data (Yale-Brain-Mets-Longitudinal)
population: 1,430 patients with clinically confirmed brain metastases, contributing 11,892 longitudinal brain MRI studies
summary: Longitudinal brain MRI studies in NIfTI format with T1 pre- and post-contrast, T2 and FLAIR sequences, plus a spreadsheet of demographics, scanner details and acquisition parameters.
